Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Driving sales vs. Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff

Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services

standards

Preventive Maintenance

Inventory, Shop Maintenance

Knowledge of fleet operations and truck logistics
Strong coordination and communication skills
Basic knowledge of transport regulations and safety standards
Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple trips
Proficiency in MS Excel and tracking systems / TMS

Graduate / Diploma in Logistics, Transportation, Supply Chain, or related field (preferred).
2-3 years of experience in truck operations, fleet planning, or logistics tracking
Experience with self-owned fleet operations is an advantage

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the

maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.

Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.

Provide technical inputs to prioritisation and decision-making processes based on economic viability, sustainability, and value for money.

CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).

Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.

Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in development, health, education, or nutrition programmes at the district level.
Qualifications
Post-graduation in Home Science, Nutrition, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Working knowledge of the education department system in UP is required.

Field Implementation Facilitate teacher training sessions using the KiDS manual in assigned schools.
Support trained teachers in conducting diabetes awareness sessions with students.
Organise and facilitate parent-teacher meetings in project schools.
Map the communities linked to each project school and conduct community awareness meetings.
Identify and support diabetes ambassadors within communities who can sustain awareness efforts beyond the project period.
Documentation and Reporting Document all field activities systematically and compile data for submission to the District Coordinator / Programme Manager.
Provide field data and inputs for programme reports in coordination with the ME Officer.
Maintain complete records of referrals to health facilities, forms, and related documentation.
Travel The role requires approximately 20 days of field travel per month. Travel and logistics support will be provided under the project.
Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered.

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal. Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure.
Managing cash (system & physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures.
Create new CUID in system &modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments & LoanClosure.
Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff & Customer Visits etc.
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents.
Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments.
Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.
Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service.

Incentives extra - Best in the industry

JOB DESCRIPTION
Assistant Restaurant Manager WOW! momo
Department: Operations
Designation: Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)
Industry: Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) / Food & Beverage
Reports To: Restaurant Manager / Area Operations Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: As per business requirement
About WOW! momo
WOW! momo is one of India’s leading homegrown QSR brands, known for its innovative food offerings, customer-centric approach, and fast-growing restaurant network. We are looking for energetic, customer-focused, and result-oriented professionals to join our restaurant operations team.
Job Purpose
To support the Restaurant Manager in managing day-to-day restaurant operations, ensuring excellent customer experience, maintaining food quality and safety standards, driving sales and profitability, and developing a motivated team that consistently delivers WOW! service.
Key Responsibilities
1. Restaurant Operations
Manage daily restaurant operations and ensure smooth functioning across all shifts.
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational checklists, and company policies.
Monitor opening and closing activities, equipment functionality, cleanliness, and overall restaurant readiness.
Ensure timely order preparation, accurate billing, and efficient order delivery.
2. Sales & Business Performance
Drive daily sales and achieve assigned sales targets.
Monitor key performance indicators such as average order value, customer footfall, order accuracy, and sales growth.
Identify opportunities to improve upselling, cross-selling, and customer conversions.
Support cost control initiatives and improve restaurant profitability.
3. People Management & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Team Members and Shift Managers.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective shift scheduling.
Drive employee engagement, attendance, discipline, and retention.
Train team members on product knowledge, customer service, food preparation, and operational standards.
Identify high-potential employees and support their career growth through on-the-job training and development.
4. Customer Experience
Ensure exceptional customer service and a positive dining experience.
Handle customer complaints and resolve service issues promptly.
Maintain service speed, product consistency, and order accuracy.
Build customer loyalty through friendly, efficient, and professional service.
5. Food Safety & Quality
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and food handling standards.
Monitor product quality, portion control, freshness, and adherence to recipes.
Ensure proper storage, stock rotation, and expiry-date monitoring.
Maintain a clean, safe, and hygienic restaurant environment.
6. Inventory & Cost Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure timely stock replenishment.
Minimize food wastage, pilferage, and operational losses.
Conduct stock counts and support inventory reconciliation.
Monitor consumption, food cost, packaging cost, and other controllable expenses.
7. Cash Management & Compliance
Ensure accurate cash handling, billing, POS operations, and end-of-day reconciliation.
Maintain operational records, registers, and reports as required.
Follow company policies and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper handling of cash, inventory, and other company assets.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate preferred; candidates with relevant qualifications and QSR experience may also be considered.
Experience: 2–4 years of experience in restaurant operations, preferably in QSR, food service, or retail operations.
Prior experience in team handling, shift management, customer service, and sales performance is preferred.
Required Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Customer-first attitude and problem-solving ability.
Sales orientation and business acumen.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
Knowledge of inventory management, cash handling, and food safety.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and holidays as per business requirements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of restaurant sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
Food cost, wastage, and controllable expense management.
Employee attendance, retention, and manpower availability.
Food safety, hygiene, and audit compliance scores.
Order accuracy and service speed.
Team productivity, training completion, and internal promotions.
Career Growth
At WOW! momo, high-performing Assistant Restaurant Managers can develop their leadership capabilities and progress toward Restaurant Manager and higher operations leadership roles, based on performance and business requirements.
Why Join WOW! momo?
Opportunity to work with a growing Indian QSR brand.
Performance-driven work culture.
Hands-on operational and leadership development.
Career growth opportunities within the organization.
Join WOW! momo and be part of a team that delivers great food, great service, and a WOW! customer experience every day.

Key Aspects:
Product Range:
Frozen Momos: This is a core offering, allowing customers to enjoy Wow! Momo's products at home.
Wow! Noodles: A recent addition, featuring a range of "Desi-Asian" flavored instant noodles.
Other Products: Includes items like Wow! Smiley, with plans to expand into categories like kulfi, Beverages called coco charge
Growth and Strategy:
Aggressive expansion in the FMCG segment is underway.
The company aims to establish the FMCG division as a substantial revenue contributor.
Focus on both online (e-commerce, especially quick commerce) and offline (general trade stores, modern trade outlets) distribution channels.
Financials:
The FMCG segment is currently smaller than the QSR business but exhibits rapid growth.
Ambitious revenue targets have been set for the FMCG division.
Overall: Wow! Momo is leveraging its brand to diversify into the FMCG sector, offering convenient food products to a broader consumer base.

A Head of Solar Projects leads the end-to-end execution of large-scale (MW-level) solar projects, managing design, procurement, site construction, and commissioning. Technical Oversight: Review designs, technology selection, and system configurations (civil and electrical).
Regulatory & Safety Compliance: Ensure adherence to safety standards and local, state, and national regulations.
Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with clients, contractors, and government agencies.

Experience: 18-28 years of experience in solar project management.
Education: Bachelors or Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical).
Skills: Strong knowledge of EPC, project planning tools, ROW (Right-of-Way) management, and HT termination.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Proven track record in managing MW-scale or GW-capacity solar projects.
Excellent leadership and team management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Job Description:
Objective: The purpose of the role is to execute all channel related activities for the designated area through vendor which includes eating and drinking, modern trade, mom and pop retailers, grocery and non traditional channels or point of sale and vendor management
Title: Team Leader Channel
Function: Commercial
Work Location: Indore, Pune
Job Responsibilities:
Channel Programs
1. Execution of unit specific initiatives in E&D, Grocery, and Convenience channel as per plan shared
2. Ensure outlet activation execution as per RED standards
3. Ensure support development and implementation of unit activation plans, using approved national/regional channel standards.
4. Planning of standard approved activation elements & other marketing collaterals
5. Execution and portfolio management as per the plan shared
Across depots & distributors
1. Execution of local initiatives
2. Tracking of systems and evaluation process
3. Local Initiatives to scale up the national/regional program
Analysis and Reporting
1. Activation as per RED / DEEP RED to do list.
2. Identify gaps & growth opportunities in various channels as per PITA model
3. Tracking of competition activities
4. Ensure activation in market through analysis RSA data
Supervises: None
Direct Reports: None
Geographical Scope:
Reports To: Area Channel Manager/Channel Manager
Key Customers:
Internal Customers: Sales Team at the Unit, Finance, RTM
External Customers: Vendors, Suppliers, Distributors, Key Accounts, Agencies, Customers
Job Requirements:
Qualifications: Graduation/M.B.A.
Experience: 4-8 Years
Functional Skills:
Customer Management (a)-Competent
Financial Knowledge / Application and Appreciation (a)- Working Knowledge
Market Execution (a)-Competent
Planning and Analytics (b)-Working Knowledge
Sales Management (b)-Working Knowledge
Travel: Above 75%

Role Overview:
Lead all engineering, technical maintenance, HSE, and AMC operations at The Client's Powai facility, ensuring a safe, compliant, and high-performing facility environment. Oversee critical building systems, statutory compliance, vendor management, and operational excellence as per Master Service Agreement requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage all technical operations, maintenance, and uptime for site systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, lifts, and water systems
Regularly review asset health, preventive maintenance schedules, system performance, and identify improvement opportunities
Plan and execute all technical preparations for meetings, conferences, client visits, and special events
Perform daily check-ins and inspections around facility to ensure high technical and safety standards
Ensure 100% compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements including labour, fire, EHS, DG, lifts, FSSAI, and environmental laws
Maintain audit-ready documentation, statutory registers, and ensure timely submissions of compliance reports
Develop and enforce SOPs for technical operations, safety procedures, and emergency response protocols
Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) preparedness, conduct drills, and coordinate emergency response procedures
Coordinate and manage AMC vendor partners: validate contract compliance, oversee maintenance delivery, and schedule preventive and corrective work
Review vendor service reports, close technical findings, and ensure quality standards are met
Manage contractors and service providers: qualification checks, safety plan reviews, EHS document control, and ongoing performance monitoring
Conduct regular technical, safety, and risk audits; investigate incidents and drive corrective action closure
Provide staff HSE and safety training; promote safety culture across facility operations
Submit all compliance, audit, incident, and performance reports accurately and on time
Maintain operational and technical records as per contract and regulatory requirements
Drive sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, technology adoption, and continuous service improvements
Collaborate with Facility Manager, site leadership, vendors, and client stakeholders on priorities, procurement, and budget management
Identify and implement best practices to help facility systems perform at optimal levels
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil) or related technical discipline
5-7 years of progressive experience in facilities management, engineering operations, or HSE leadership roles
Strong knowledge of building systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, and critical infrastructure
Understanding of statutory compliance requirements including fire safety, EHS regulations, and environmental laws
Experience with AMC/vendor management, contract compliance, and service delivery oversight
Proficiency in audit management, documentation, and regulatory reporting
Working knowledge of digital FM tools, CMMS, and technical reporting systems
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
Team leadership skills with capability to coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors
Tertiary qualifications in building management, facility management, or business management preferred
Certifications in safety, fire safety, or facility management are advantageous

On behalf of its clients, the firm provides management and real estate outsourcing services for a property portfolio of 4.0 billion square feet, or 372 million square meters, and completed $138 billion in sales, acquisitions and finance transactions in 2015. Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
Position Summary:
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA or master’s degree is preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
9-14 years of professional work experience with at least 6 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory & Azure Databricks.
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.

Job Description

HGS has been assisting global customers since 2003 bringing data to life as their Trusted Analytics and Planning partner. Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
Job Summary
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic individual for the position of Associate Agency Development Manager. The successful candidate will play a key role in driving the growth of our agency business by recruiting, training, and managing a team of insurance advisors. You will work closely with your team to develop strategic plans and execute initiatives that maximize sales performance and enhance customer satisfaction.
Responsibilities
Recruit, train, and develop a team of insurance advisors to meet sales targets.
Monitor and evaluate the performance of advisors, providing ongoing feedback and support.
Develop and implement marketing strategies to drive agency growth and enhance market presence.
Build and maintain relationships with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored insurance solutions.
Conduct regular training sessions and workshops to enhance the skills and knowledge of the advisory team.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that all operational and compliance standards are met.
Analyze sales data and market trends to inform decision-making and track progress towards targets.
Skills and Tools Required
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with clients and team members.
Proven leadership capabilities with a focus on team development and performance management.
Excellent analytical skills to assess performance metrics and market data.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and presentations.
Knowledge of the insurance industry and regulatory environment.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-centric approach to service.
This position offers an excellent opportunity for career growth within a leading insurance organization. If you are passionate about building teams and driving sales in the insurance industry, we encourage you to apply.

Job Purpose
Responsible for evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digital channels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYC verification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieve seamless, paperless disbursements.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate digital loan applications within defined turnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules.
Perform digital KYC, bureau checks, income surrogates, and fraud screening; escalate suspicious cases.
Prepare concise credit notes/CAMs for non-STP or exception cases; recommend decisions as per DOA.
Ensure accurate documentation and track postdisbursement document (PDD) closure where applicable.
Coordinate with sales/operations for clarifications, rework, and smooth disbursement.
Monitor early vintage performance/FPD for approved cases and provide feedback to improve filters.
Adhere to underwriting policy, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards, clear QA observations PDs of specific cases.
Skills Required
Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
Knowledge of retail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency in digital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention to detail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience
Graduate / Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
1-3 years in credit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Assists in formulating an approved vendors list encompassing all categories.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 4-year bachelors degree in Fice and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Work, Projects, Policies, and Standards for Purchasing Across Departments
- Assists with generating and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.
- Assures sanitation compliance.
- Assists Executive Chef in all aspects of purchasing (eg, Food, Beverage and Controllable) to ensure quality and profitability.
- Orders all food and beverage based on business needs.
- Assists Executive Chef in maintaining/lower budgeted food/controllable costs.
- Assists in enforcing first in/first out inventory rotation for all storeroom products.
- Maintains sanitation and safety standards as specified in the brand guidelines.
- Ensures that proper safeguards are in effect for the security of the food and beverage storeroom assets.
- Enforces item use-up with storeroom personnel and kitchen management to keep inventory at lowest level possible levels.
- Communicates with kitchen, restaurant management and vendors to ensure timing of deliveries satisfies advanced food production needs.
- Checks invoice on goods received against shipment to ensure quantity, quality, weights and purchase specifications are as ordered.
- Uses existing computer programs to perform daily and period end food and beverage costs.
- Maintains inventory controls for proper levels, dating, rotation, requisitions, etc
- Completes administrative tasks on a timely basis (eg, C-7s, menu costing, general office duties).
- Completes period end inventory according to Food and Beverage and Accounting standard operation procedures.
- Calculates figures for food and beverage inventory.
- Ensures that price and product availability issues are communicated as needed to the F & B Director and Executive Chef.
- Assists in receiving and inspecting all deliveries.
- Maintains an accurate controllable log and beverage perpetual.
- Ensures accurate administration of all invoices, and adherence to proper bookkeeping procedures.
Demonstrating and Applying Accounting Knowledge to Purchasing Operations
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Uses computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.
- Uses relevant information and individual judgment to determine whether events or processes comply with laws, regulations, or standards.
- Keeps up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.
- Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of A.
S.
I.
standards.
Maintaining Fice and Accounting Goals
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Ensures profits and losses are documented accurately.
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Interacts with kitchen staff, vendors and Executive Chef.
- Uses existing computer programs effectively to post invoices, update items and costs.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
- Provide direction and assistance to other organizational units regarding accounting and budgeting policies and procedures, and efficient control and utilization of ficial resources.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart SalesAssociate

Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score

Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation

Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priorityRole & responsibilities
Note :
Family Insurance Policy and Monthly Incentive policy
Professionalized Training with Lenskart Academy ( Mandatory )

Description:
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Note :
Family Insurance Policy and Monthly Incentive policy
Professionalized Training with Lenskart Academy ( Mandatory ).

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.
Use product knowledge and sales techniques to upsell and cross-sell products, maximizing sales opportunities.
Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently, including cash handling, credit card transactions, and billing inquiries.
Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment, ensuring that merchandise is properly displayed and priced.
Perform regular inventory checks, restock shelves, and assist with merchandise deliveries as needed.
Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner, escalating to management as necessary.
Stay updated on product offerings, promotions, and company policies to provide accurate information to customers.
Collaborate with team members to achieve sales targets, meet customer service goals, and ensure the overall success of the store.

Qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent.
Previous retail or customer service experience is preferred but not required.
Friendly and outgoing personality with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to go above and beyond to meet customer needs.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and multitask with attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Description:

As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 20-25 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions

Variable compensation based on sales performance
Travel allowances

Training:
30-days comprehensive training in Navi Mumbai on eye checkups and sales techniques
Candidates must be willing to stay/travel to the training location for 30 days

Graduate or Diploma holder
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Officer for the role of CAT (Customer Analytics and Transformation) - Loyalty. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing loyalty programs that enhance customer engagement and retention. This role involves analyzing customer data, identifying trends, and implementing strategies that foster long-term relationships with clients.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement loyalty programs that cater to customer needs and enhance overall satisfaction.
- Analyze customer data to identify patterns and preferences, using insights to drive decision-making.
- Collaborate with marketing and product teams to align loyalty initiatives with business objectives.
- Monitor the performance of loyalty programs and suggest improvements based on feedback and analysis.
- Engage with customers to gather insights and refine loyalty strategies, ensuring continuous improvement.
- Prepare reports and presentations for management to provide updates on loyalty program performance and impact.

Skills Required:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various stakeholders.
- Proficiency in customer analytics tools and techniques.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.

Tools Required:
- Familiarity with CRM software and customer analytics platforms.
- Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, or other relevant software.
- Experience with reporting and visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
- Knowledge of marketing automation tools will be a plus.

Candidates with a background in data analytics, customer experience, or marketing will be preferred for this position. Join Axis Max Life Insurance and contribute to building lasting customer relationships through innovative loyalty programs.

Job Title
Job Title- Service executive


Job Summary
Overview Would you like to join a truly international, talent driven company that values Safety, Ethics, Quality, Innovation and Employee Opportunity Otis is growing and is looking for a maintenance mechanic for one of our entities located in Indore. Your priority is to ensure the safety of passengers and technical stakeholders by safely maintaining a portfolio of elevator and escalator units. On a typical day you will: Carry out 100% of the elevator maintenance and service visits of the units within your territory Work within your defined geographical area / territory, managing the portfolio of elevators within it Respond proactively and quickly to fix any breakdowns, aiming to achieve first time fix Carry out minor repairs to achieve continual operation Liaise directly with the customer while on site to build a good working relationship What you will need to be successful (adjust for local regulations) Reference qualifications that are required for maintenance mechanics in your country Hold a drivers license . You have at least 24 months of experience in the elevator sector You have good skills in electricity and electrical engineering You are a committed professional, with safety as your priority You are comfortable communicating to others You are curious, adaptable, and you know how to work alone or in a team You are comfortable using electronic and digital tools. What s In it For Me / Benefits You will receive a long-term employment contract with the world market leader in a crisis-proof industry. Work schedule will in 3 shifts. You will receive modern and high-quality work clothes, your own tools, an iPhone. The health and safety of our employees is our top priority. We promote this through regular training on the subject of occupational health and safety as well as through an employee support program.

Liaise directly with the customer while on site to build a good working relationship


Requirements

achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to beDriving Net
Promoter Score Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers Driving sales vs. Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership plan Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff

(Attrition Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates

Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Cash & Inventory Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions management are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart CustomerEnsuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
Supervision are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
SOP adherence & implementation Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the storeMaintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
Store up keep & maintenance equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal at tributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Graduate

Ability to develop and inspire people to achieve their best
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand stated and unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Excellent interpersonal skills

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Attention todetail and compliance orientation.

Graduate /Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
13 years incredit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesnt stop there. Were developing breakthrough technology to power the worlds future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.

Application specific MCU industrial (ASM-IND) product line offers a broad range of high performance, innovative and cost-effective specialized MCUs for a wide range of applications across Motor control and Digital power. We enable powering next generation AI datacenters, provide motor control solutions for Humanoids, robotics, etc., build AI solutions for predictive diagnostics, improve performance, control and optimize energy efficiency.
We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to continuously learn, innovate, take an active role in solving real time control. It is a fast paced, results driven environment requiring Microcontroller knowledge, system level understanding, software development, Motor control algorithms and system hardware skillsets. You will collaborate with worldwide accounts to solve their system challenges, enable them to go to market faster, work with marketing and business leadership to develop strategic technical solutions to enable TI business growth and impact the next generation of products.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop sensored and sensor less motor control algorithms to enable faster response, Smoother speed, less acoustic noise
Own specific IP s write technical reference manual, resolve customer issues through E2E platform and field engagement
Participate in customer calls to understand system requirements and help select the right devices and reference designs
Support customer design-in activities by:
Adapting our system reference solutions to their custom hardware design.
Meet customer across the globe to promote our technical benefits and resolve technical issues / Debug
Schematic and layout review of customer solutions for our device
Help with software porting, optimize software to improve performance.
Resolve production stop issues for customers
Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support evaluation activities of new products.
Train Field Applications Engineers and customers on ASM Microcontrollers and reference designs
Write application notes and training collateral that explain features, implementation of motor control on ASM Microcontrollers.
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Master s degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree
3 years of application/system engineering experience
Motor control algorithm development
Strong knowledge of Microcontrollers
Experience in embedded C software development
Solid hardware and software debugging skills

Preferred qualifications:
PHD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Drive Systems
Hands-on experience working in motor control algorithm development
Knowledge on Matlab, Simulink and Plexim for simulation and model-based code generation
Digital control system design
Familiarity with field bus communication
Power electronic system design
Knowledge on functional safety, security and artificial intelligence
Ability to review schematics and PCB layout using CAD tools
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Self-driven and ability to take initiative and drive for results
Continuous learning mindset
Ability to produce high quality technical documentation
Good communication skillset to interface with customers and Field Applications Engineers

Trrip Partner Verification Executive (PVE)

Job Description (JD) & Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

PART A JOB DESCRIPTION

1. Position
Designation: Partner Verification Executive (PVE)
Role Type: Field-Based
Location: Ooty / Coorg / Puducherry

Reporting To: Trrip Operations Team
Role Objective
The PVE is responsible for physically visiting locations assigned by Trrip and collecting fresh, accurate and complete information directly from the partner. The objective is to provide Trrip with reliable, up-to-date partner information, images and customer-useful details.
Visit Target
The PVE will be assigned approximately 55 to 60 restaurants and/or shops to visit as part of the assigned field activity. All assigned locations must be physically visited and properly verified according to this SOP.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Physical Verification
- Visit restaurants, shops and other locations assigned by Trrip.
- Physically verify that the location is operational.
- Confirm the business name and address.
- Meet the owner, manager or authorized contact person.
- Collect the correct contact person's name and number.
- Capture geo-tagged proof of the visit.
B. Partner Data Collection
- Business name
- Contact person's name and number
- WhatsApp number, if available
- Complete address and landmark
- Operating days and timings
- Services/products offered
- Other relevant partner details
C. Images & Menu Collection
- Capture minimum 5 fresh interior/location images.
- Capture exterior/name-board image.
- Capture relevant product, service and facility images where applicable.
- Collect the latest menu, rate card or brochure where applicable.
- Use Microsoft Lens, Adobe Scan or an equivalent scanning application.
- Ensure all images are clear, relevant and readable.

PART B STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE
PHASE 1
Receive Assignment
- Receive the list of restaurants, shops or other locations from Trrip.
- The assigned list will generally contain approximately 50 to 60 locations.
- Review the assigned locations.
- Plan the route and visits.
- Visit locations according to the assigned schedule.
PHASE 2
Physical Visit
Step 1: Reach the Location
- Physically visit the assigned location.
- Online verification does not count as a completed visit.

Step 2: Geo-Tagged Proof
- Keep location/GPS enabled.
- Capture a fresh exterior image showing the name board/entrance wherever possible.

Step 3: Meet the Partner
- Speak with the owner, manager or authorized representative.
- Explain that you are collecting updated information for Trrip.
PHASE 3
Collect & Verify Information
- Confirm directly with the partner: name, address, contact person, contact number, WhatsApp number, operating hours, services/products and other relevant information.
- Do not simply copy information from Google or other online platforms.
PHASE 4
Images & Menu Collection
- Capture 1 exterior/name-board image.
- Capture minimum 5 fresh interior/location images.
- Capture relevant product, service and facility images where applicable.
- Collect the latest menu, rate card or brochure where applicable.
- Use Microsoft Lens, Adobe Scan or an equivalent scanning application.
- Ensure there is no blur, glare or unnecessary shadow and that relevant pages are fully visible and readable.
- Do not submit images downloaded from Google, Instagram, Zomato, Swiggy, Justdial or other websites/platformsas fresh PVE photographs.
PHASE 5
Data Submission
- Submit partner details, contact details, address, services/products offered, fresh photographs, geo-tagged proof, menu/rate card where applicable and additional notes.
- If information is unavailable, write Not Provided.
- Never guess, assume or fabricate information.

PVE Principle
Visit Physically > Collect Directly > Verify Accurately > Submit Completely
