Job Title: US IT Recruiter Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0–5+ Years
Shift: Night Shift – US Staffing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels — Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.
The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.
Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.
Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations
Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–5 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (5+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Maintenance Management
Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment.
Ensure maximum machine uptime and minimize production losses.
Analyze equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Monitor machine performance and reliability indicators.
2. Equipment Maintenance
Maintain and improve the performance of:
Stator winding machines
Coil insertion machines
Commutator assembly machines
Rotor balancing machines
Press machines
Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Conveyor systems
Assembly line equipment
Gear box, Index table, LM guides, Ball screws, clutches
Utility systems (air compressors, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, etc.)
Material handling equipment
3. TPM & Continuous Improvement
Drive TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) activities across production areas.
Implement Autonomous Maintenance (JH & PM Pillar) initiatives.
Conduct root cause analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead Kaizen and cost-reduction projects.
Support OEE improvement initiatives.
4. Planning & Scheduling
Develop annual, monthly, and weekly maintenance plans.
Coordinate maintenance schedules with production teams.
Ensure timely completion of shutdown maintenance activities.
5. Spare Parts & Inventory Control
Monitor critical spare inventory levels.
Coordinate procurement of maintenance spares.
Optimize spare consumption and maintenance costs.
Maintain proper records of equipment history and spare utilization.
6. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with EHS policies and statutory requirements.
Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance activities.
Ensure safe work practices among maintenance personnel and contractors.
7. Team Management
Lead, guide, and develop maintenance engineers, technicians, and trainees.
Conduct skill development and technical training programs.
Evaluate team performance and support succession planning.
8. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain maintenance records through CMMS/ERP systems.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Track maintenance KPIs such as:
•MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
•MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
•OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
•Maintenance Cost per Unit
•Preventive Maintenance Compliance

Preferred candidate profile

Location: Puducherry; Candidates who are native of Puducherry are also welcome

Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Overview
Service Managers (SM) or Territory Managers (TM) are the frontline owner of fleet quality, safety compliance and ground-level service execution resulting in top-notch customer experience.
Core Responsibilities
Service Quality –
1. Completing daily in-bus inspections and fill the audit form to improve service delivery
2. Own audit score and bus-quality-complaints-per-trip metric, and zero compromise on safety violations
3. Ensure cleanliness, comfort and onboard amenities meet brand standard on every trip
4. Daily coordination with operator staff to get the work done and highlighting improvement areas
5. Calling unhappy customers daily and gather captain & crew feedback to close the loop; resolve issues at the right quality, not just speed
6. Working on reducing customer complaints related to bus condition, cleanliness and safety concerns
 Team Leadership & Accountability -
1. Recruit, train and manage the team of bus captains ensuring grooming standards and timely reporting
2. Own roster planning, week-offs, attendance and attrition control
3. Drive accountability through audits and performance evaluation; log corrective actions against the SOP checklist; keep behavioral complaints under check
4. Deliver on customer engagement targets of customer ratings and in-bus bookings
 Reporting & Continuous Improvement -
1. Own the reports assigned to this role, flag trends and make corrections
2. Monitor service and captain level performance through performance dashboards
3. Bus punctuality reports to be seen daily and making timely schedule/route corrections
4. Log daily checklist of SOPs and ensure team down the line improve on deliverables
 Required Skills & Availability
 Working knowledge of bus systems, fleet maintenance basics and safety regulations
 Proven people-management and training ability for a frontline team
 Composure and firmness enforcing standards under operational pressure, including the authority to hold a bus back from dispatch
 Strong coordination and stakeholder communication — captains, crew, customers and the operator
 Comfortable working late nights and staying reachable off-hours while services are running

Sumangala Steel Private Limited is one of Indias leading manufacturers of premium quality TMT bars with over 40 years of industry expertise. With a manufacturing capacity of 200,000 tons per annum and a turnover of Rs. 1000 Crores, the company has built a strong brand presence across South India.

Visit construction sites, infrastructure projects and other relevant developments in the vicinity of assigned dealers or dealer groups.

Connect with builders, contractors, civil engineers, structural consultants and other key project decision-makers.
Introduce and promote Sumangala 550D CRS TMT bars, highlighting their quality, strength and suitability for construction projects.
Facilitate connections between prospective customers and authorised Sumangala Steel dealers to convert leads into sales.
Develop and maintain a database of construction projects and potential customers within the assigned territory.
Regularly follow up on leads and track their progress in coordination with dealers.
Submit periodic reports on site visits, project enquiries, leads generated and business opportunities.
Build strong relationships within the local construction and engineering community.
Desired Profile
3-8 years of experience in civil engineering, construction, building materials, steel or a related industry.
Good understanding of construction practices, project execution and the local construction market.
Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
Ability to identify business opportunities and generate quality leads through regular field visits.
Familiarity with local builders, contractors, engineers and construction projects will be an advantage.
Self-motivated, proactive and capable of working independently from the assigned location.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
Basic computer skills and the ability to maintain project and lead reports.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Maintenance Management
Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment.
Ensure maximum machine uptime and minimize production losses.
Analyze equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Monitor machine performance and reliability indicators.

2. Equipment Maintenance
Maintain and improve the performance of:
Stator winding machines
Coil insertion machines
Commutator assembly machines
Rotor balancing machines
Press machines
Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Conveyor systems
Assembly line equipment
Gear box, Index table, LM guides, Ball screws, clutches
Utility systems (air compressors, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, etc.)
Material handling equipment

3. TPM & Continuous Improvement
Drive TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) activities across production areas.
Implement Autonomous Maintenance (JH & PM Pillar) initiatives.
Conduct root cause analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead Kaizen and cost-reduction projects.
Support OEE improvement initiatives.

4. Planning & Scheduling
Develop annual, monthly, and weekly maintenance plans.
Coordinate maintenance schedules with production teams.
Ensure timely completion of shutdown maintenance activities.

5. Spare Parts & Inventory Control
Monitor critical spare inventory levels.
Coordinate procurement of maintenance spares.
Optimize spare consumption and maintenance costs.
Maintain proper records of equipment history and spare utilization.

6. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with EHS policies and statutory requirements.
Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance activities.
Ensure safe work practices among maintenance personnel and contractors.

7. Team Management
Lead, guide, and develop maintenance engineers, technicians, and trainees.
Conduct skill development and technical training programs.
Evaluate team performance and support succession planning.

8. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain maintenance records through CMMS/ERP systems.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Track maintenance KPIs such as:
MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
Maintenance Cost per Unit
Preventive Maintenance Compliance


Preferred candidate profile

Qualification filter: B.E./B.Tech/Diploma Mechanical Engineering
Experience filter: 5 to 12 years
Preferred industry: Automotive / Auto Components / Electric Motor Manufacturing / Engineering Manufacturing.

Company Profile
Gold Plus Group is the second-largest glass manufacturing company in India, with its Head

Presentable

Description:
Position: Floor Manager (Supermarket)

Industry: Supermarket / Hypermarket / Retail
Department: Store Operations
Reporting To: Store Manager
Location: Villianur & Pondicherry
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose
The Floor Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the supermarket sales floor, ensuring excellent customer service, effective staff deployment, proper product availability and display, and smooth store operations to achieve sales target.
The role requires strong leadership, customer-handling, merchandising, inventory-control and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

1. Floor Operations
Manage daily sales-floor operations and ensure smooth functioning of all departments.
Ensure the store is ready for business before opening and properly managed until closing.
Monitor customer flow and ensure a clean, organized and pleasant shopping environment.
Conduct regular floor walks and identify operational issues.
Coordinate with back-store, warehouse, billing and other departments for smooth operations.
2. Team Management
Supervise and guide sales staff, department staff, promoters and support employees.
Allocate staff to departments based on business requirements and customer traffic.
Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming and discipline.
Conduct daily briefings and communicate targets, promotions and operational instructions.
Coach employees on customer service, product knowledge and selling techniques.
Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
3. Sales & Target Achievement
Drive daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.
Monitor department-wise sales performance and identify gaps.
Encourage upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure promotional activities and offers are properly communicated to customers.
Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products and take corrective action with the relevant teams.
4. Stock & Inventory Management
Ensure shelves are adequately stocked and products are replenished on time.
Monitor stock availability and coordinate with inventory/warehouse teams.
Ensure proper FIFO/FEFO practices, particularly for grocery, dairy, fresh and perishable products.
Identify damaged, expired, near-expiry and slow-moving products.
Support stock counts, audits and inventory reconciliation.
Monitor stock discrepancies and assist in shrinkage/loss-prevention control.
5. Merchandising & Display
Ensure products are displayed according to company merchandising standards.
Maintain correct pricing, labels, shelf tags and promotional displays.
Ensure planograms and promotional displays are implemented correctly where applicable.
Maintain attractive, clean and well-organized shelves and aisles.
6. Customer Service
Ensure customers receive prompt and professional service.
Handle customer queries, complaints and escalations effectively.
Resolve routine customer issues and escalate major issues to the Store Manager.
Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the shopping experience.
7. Billing & Cash Operations
Monitor billing-counter operations during peak hours.
Ensure adequate cashier deployment.
Coordinate with the cashier/team to minimize billing queues.
Support accurate billing and cash-handling procedures.
Report billing or POS-related issues promptly.
8. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance
Ensure cleanliness and hygiene standards are maintained throughout the sales floor.
Ensure employees follow company policies, safety procedures and grooming standards.
Monitor food-safety requirements in applicable departments.
Report safety hazards, equipment issues and other operational risks immediately.
9. Reporting & Administration
Prepare or provide daily operational updates to the Store Manager.
Monitor sales, stock availability, customer complaints, staff attendance and other relevant KPIs.
Maintain records related to floor operations.
Support internal audits, stock audits and management inspections.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of daily/monthly sales targets
Sales growth and conversion
Customer satisfaction
Stock availability / out-of-stock percentage

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Responsibilities
Lead and manage all aspects of the store's operations, including sales performance, customer service, staff management, inventory control, and financial targets.
Develop and implement strategies to maximize sales and profitability while ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
Recruit, train, and supervise a high-performing team, fostering a positive and motivating work environment.
Set and achieve sales targets, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and analyze trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
Maintain inventory accuracy, oversee merchandising, and ensure that the store maintains a visually appealing and organized appearance. Implement effective marketing and promotional activities to drive customer traffic and enhance brand awareness.
Handle customer inquiries, complaints, and escalations in a professional and timely manner, ensuring customer satisfaction and retention.
Manage expenses, budgets, and financial reporting, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
Collaborate with upper management to develop and execute strategic plans aligned with company objectives.
Requirements
Proven experience as a Store Manager or in a similar role within the retail industry.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a team to achieve goals.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to interact effectively with customers, staff, and stakeholders.
Proficiency in retail management software, MS Office, and basic financial analysis.
Sound understanding of sales and marketing principles.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.

- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).

- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.

- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

- Participates in department meetings.

- Develops liaison with local law enforcement and emergency services.

Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.

Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps.

Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.
At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury.
It is high-touch, personalized, creative and original.
It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
The Senior Butler oversees the functioning and delivery of butler services.
You verify that there is a seamless approach to the pre-arrival, guest stay and at departure through St.
Regis brand standards.
You supervise the work of the Butler team - comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets - and drive strong coordination with other departments.
Responsibilities also include people management tasks including interviewing and hiring Butler team members and creating schedules to ensure optimal staffing levels.
While the St.
Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service.
The Senior Butler s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, the ability to anticipate needs and impeccable interpersonal skills.
You will also be expected to create a safe workplace, follow company policies and procedures, uphold quality standards, and ensure your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Butler team members will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Butler team members - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS
Related Work Experience: 1 year related work experience required.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events.
This position primarily handles events of average complexity.
Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales.
Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 - 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Event Logistics and Operations
- Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
- Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.
- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments

Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Experience: 5-8 Years
Location: Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure DevOps Engineer with 5-8 years of experience in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps practices. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, and monitoring solutions to support large-scale enterprise applications.

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, deployment, and release management processes.
Manage and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure and services.
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep.
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
Monitor application and infrastructure performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
Collaborate with Development, QA, Security, and Operations teams to streamline software delivery.
Implement DevSecOps best practices and security compliance controls.
Troubleshoot deployment issues, system bottlenecks, and infrastructure incidents.
Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of cloud environments.
Maintain documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and operational procedures.

YAML-based pipeline development

Git and Branching Strategies

PowerShell
Azure CLI

Docker
Kubernetes (AKS)

Description:
ETL Testing Engineer
Job Title
ETL Testing Engineer / Data Warehouse Tester
Experience
3 -10 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled ETL Testing Engineer to validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes in data warehouse and business intelligence environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong SQL skills, hands-on ETL testing experience, and expertise in data validation and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business and technical requirements related to data migration and ETL processes.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems to target databases.
Perform data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation testing.
Verify data mappings, transformation rules, and business logic.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects through defect management tools.
Perform regression, integration, system, and UAT support testing.
Validate data quality and consistency across multiple platforms.
Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test metrics, reports, and test execution status updates.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of ETL Testing concepts and methodologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as:
Informatica
SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
Talend
DataStage
Ab Initio
Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation.
Experience with Data Warehouse concepts including:
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Fact and Dimension Tables
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
Experience with database platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
Expertise in data quality and data migration testing.
Familiarity with defect tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
Preferred Skills
Automation experience using Python, Selenium, or ETL automation frameworks.
Experience with cloud data platforms:
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Synapse
AWS Glue
Snowflake
Databricks
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (Hive, Hadoop, Spark).
Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
Performance and volume testing experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Certification in ETL, Data Warehousing, or Database technologies is a plus.

8-15 years,Relocation for(bangalore,Pune,Hyderabad,Coimbatore)

Role & responsibilities :-
-Experience in Data migration from SAP/Non-SAP to S/4 HANA on premises with full life cycle implementation
- Expertise of migration SAP BODS and Migration Cockpit, with experience in at least 3 projects

- Excellent written and Oral communication skills
- Working experience of data transformations and data migration and implementation for SAP.
-- Overview on functional analysis and requirements gathering, and solid understanding of SAP.

We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

Years of Experience
5-9 Years

Position Requirements
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling expert with hands-on solution design, configuration, testing and deployment experience; preferably with an accounts/finance and cost/management accounting background.
Strong, demonstrable expertise in CO sub-modules: CO-CCA (Cost Center Accounting), CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting), CO-PC (Product Costing) product cost planning, standard cost estimates, cost estimate with/without quantity structure, mixed costing, variance analysis, WIP calculation, and settlement — Material Ledger (ML) and Actual Costing — multi-level actual costing run, periodic unit price, alternative valuation runs, parallel currencies/valuations — along with Profitability Analysis (CO-PA — costing-based and/or account-based), Internal Orders, and Overhead Cost Controlling, alongside FI-GL, FI-AR, FI-AP, Asset Accounting and ICMR.
Proven, hands-on experience configuring Controlling building blocks end-to-end: cost element/cost center hierarchies, activity types and planning, allocation cycles (assessment/distribution), costing sheets, cost component structures, Material Ledger activation and actual costing configuration, and profitability reporting structures.
Full lifecycle exposure to Product Costing and Material Ledger solutions — from requirement gathering and design (blueprinting/fit-gap), through configuration, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover, and post-go-live deployment support.
Ability to mentor and manage multiple teams and projects, with CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design ownership across workstreams.
Participate in design discussions, providing deep expertise on SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling capabilities (e.g., universal journal-based CO-FI real-time integration, margin analysis, Material Ledger as the valuation backbone in S/4HANA).
Work with business/controlling users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions for cost allocation, product costing, inventory valuation, and profitability reporting.
Develop a collaborative, cohesive team culture with a “One Team” mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance, Controlling and management accounting processes, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop, configure and test integrations between CO/Product Costing/Material Ledger and other modules — MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly cost flows from procurement, production, and project systems into Controlling and inventory valuation objects.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable real-time transactional-level matching.
Understanding of AIF, field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.

Role & responsibilities

About the Role The Program Specialist is responsible for serving as the customers primary point of contact providing operational and reimbursement support to complex programs within Neovance , including but not limited to, marketing support, reimbursement hotlines, patient assistance programs, Hubs, foundations, safety surveillance programs, case management, and compliance programs. The focus of the Program Specialist is to own issues and remove obstacles that prevent patients or providers from accessing the therapies requested. The Program Specialist will be a self-starter who is comfortable taking initiative, identifying barriers, and working with the appropriate parties to eliminate these obstructions for the customer. The Program Specialist is proficient and knowledgeable about all the services provided on an assigned program and may support multiple client products or programs.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Pharmacy Patient Care Coordinator, you will be the voice patients, providers, and pharmacies rely on when they call in with questions about their therapy. You will support inbound calls tied to Patient Access Programs, HUB services, benefits verification, prior authorization, and pharmacy support, guiding callers through complex healthcare and reimbursement processes with clarity, patience, and genuine care.
This is a highly regulated, high volume calling environment, and you will be expected to bring both empathy and precision to every conversation, balancing quality and compliance standards while helping people move forward on their treatment journey.

What You'll Do:

Manage high volume inbound calls from patients, providers, and pharmacies regarding therapy status, prescriptions, and program questions.
Support callers across Patient Access Programs, HUB services, benefits verification, prior authorization, and pharmacy support processes.
Build trust and rapport with patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers through clear, confident, and empathetic communication.
Simplify complex healthcare, insurance, and reimbursement information into language patients can easily understand.
Ask probing questions and paraphrase what you hear to confirm understanding and avoid miscommunication.
Research across multiple systems and knowledge bases to identify the correct resolution, owning issues through to completion.
Document every interaction accurately and completely, maintaining the compliance and quality standards required in a regulated healthcare environment.
Manage call flow and back-to-back conversations while meeting Average Handle Time, First Call Resolution, and quality expectations.
Respond to vulnerable, frustrated, or anxious patients with composure, recognizing emotional cues and adapting your approach accordingly.

What You'll Bring:

Education & Experience

Bachelors degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
Minimum two years of experience in an international contact center or inbound voice support environment.
US healthcare experience is mandatory, preferably within Patient Access Programs, HUB, Reimbursement, Pharmacy Support, Benefits Verification, Prior Authorization, or PAP.
Experience handling patient, provider, payer, or pharmacy interactions is strongly preferred.

Skills & Strengths
Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with a neutral or globally understandable accent and minimal first language influence.
Ability to manage high volume inbound call queues while maintaining quality, compliance, and productivity standards in a fast paced environment.
Strong listening skills, with the ability to accurately capture concerns and paraphrase them back to confirm understanding.
Sound investigative and analytical thinking, with the ability to research across multiple tools and synthesize information into an accurate resolution.
Comfortable navigating multiple applications simultaneously while keeping the conversation engaged and professional.
Working understanding of call center metrics such as Average Handle Time, Quality Scores, First Call Resolution, Customer Satisfaction, Service Levels, and Adherence.
Proven experience working in a highly regulated environment requiring accurate documentation and compliance adherence.

Responsibilities
- Assisting in the management of multiple client engagements, reporting to Managers and above
- Leading and training staff to enhance team capabilities and technical skills
- Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with clients
- Contributing to the development of technical acumen within the team
- Staying informed on local and national business and economic issues
- Engaging in business development activities to identify and research opportunities with new and existing clients
- Developing internal relationships and enhancing your personal brand within PwC
- Utilizing Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) to support client solutions
- Implementing SAP Fiori and SAP HANA for process improvement and optimization
- Applying analytical thinking and strategic technology planning to drive business transformation
- Designing automation solutions to streamline client processes
- Embracing change and fostering an inclusive work environment
- Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP NetWeaver to deliver client-focused solutions
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

- Demonstrating proficiency in Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP)
- Utilizing SAP Analytics Cloud for strategic insights
- Implementing SAP Fiori for enhanced user experience
- Leveraging SAP HANA for optimized data management
- Engaging in process improvement and optimization initiatives
- Embracing change and fostering innovation in business transformation

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.

Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.

Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into backend functionalities for GenAI and Agentic AI projects.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions, including event-driven architectures and integration with external systems/APIs.

- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design principles (SOLID, clean architecture), and hands-on experience with cloud-native development on Azure/AWS, including serverless, microservices, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
- Experience with additional OOP languages (Java, C++, C#) and familiarity with WebSocket implementations for real-time application functionality.

Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.

Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Position

Job Summary

We are looking for a Production Support Engineer with strong experience in AWS Cloud Support, Java Spring Boot applications, and SQL databases. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application support, root cause analysis, and ensuring the stability and availability of production systems.
The ideal candidate should have experience supporting cloud-hosted applications, handling production incidents, analyzing logs, and collaborating with development and infrastructure teams.
Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for Java-based applications hosted on AWS.
Monitor application health, system performance, and business-critical services.
Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents within defined SLAs.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.
Analyze application logs, server logs, and database issues.
Support deployment activities and release management processes.
Work with development teams to resolve recurring production issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests through ticketing tools.
Monitor AWS infrastructure and application services.
Create and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in on-call support and production release activities.
