Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Consultant
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 5+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..
Role Summary
Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
About Accenture:
Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions - underpinned by the world's largest delivery network - Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at
About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network - a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in-country teams to deliver cutting-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit

Skills & Job Description
Lead end to end solution architecture design for SAP S/4HANA implementations, transformations, and migrations across diverse business landscapes.
Define high level business capabilities, validate requirements, and create comprehensive technical blueprints that align IT strategies with business objectives
Collaborate with cross functional teams including SAP process experts, development architects, and project management offices to ensure seamless solution delivery


Core Skills---

SAP S/4HANA Expertise
Deep knowledge of SAP S/4HANA modules including Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing
Proficiency in SAP Activate methodology for structured implementation approach
Experience with S/4HANA migration strategies, system conversion, selective data migration and greenfield implementations
Understanding of SAP S/4HANA Cloud editions (Public, Private) and deployment options
Architecture & Design
Enterprise architecture framework expertise with ability to design scalable, integrated solution landscapes
Solution component definition using SAP Transformation Navigator and architectural modelling tools
Integration architecture design covering A2A, B2B, and hybrid connectivity patterns
Cloud and Clean Core strategy implementation with focus on standardization and extensibility
Database administration knowledge, particularly SAP HANA platform optimization
Understanding of middleware technologies and integration patterns
Soft Skills & Competencies
Excellent communication and presentation skills for senior management and technical audiences
Problem solving expertise with ability to navigate complex technical and business challenges
Negotiation and influencing skills for driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
Experience Requirement
Certification Requirements
SAP Certified Professional Enterprise Architect (P_SAPEA_2023) or equivalent
SAP S/4HANA implementation and migration certifications SAP BTP Solution Architect certification preferred
TOGAF or similar enterprise architecture framework certification recommended


Key Responsibilities

Solution Design
Create comprehensive technical blueprints covering processes, integration, extensibility, and data management strategies
Validate IT scope and approve/reject requirements based on architectural feasibility and business value
Stakeholder Engagement
Conduct solution architecture workshops and present recommendations to executive leadership
Gather and validate business requirements while identifying gaps in current system landscape
Provide architectural advisory services and best practice guidance to implementation teams
Success Metrics
Successful delivery of S/4HANA implementations within scope, timeline, and budget parameters
Client satisfaction scores reflecting solution quality and architectural guidance effectiveness
Team development indicators including knowledge transfer and skill enhancement
Technical excellence benchmarks including system performance, scalability

Description:
Position: Business Analyst -Senior Techno-Functional Payment Application Designer with knowledge of domestic (NACHA, FedWire) and cross-border (SWIFT) payment schemes.
Experience: 7-20 years
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Mumbai

A talented, versatile, and hands-on **Functional Payments Expert** responsible for devising and delivering cutting-edge, innovative payment solutions. The ideal candidate is a **self-motivated individual** with strong awareness of payments industry trends, bank processing models, payment security, and end-to-end transaction lifecycles with understanding of Technology to design a solution.
Strong **business acumen**, positive work ethics, and a **collaborative mindset** are key to success in this role. The candidate will work closely with **cross-functional teams** including business, product, analytics, UX, and engineering, requiring excellent **articulation, negotiation, and influencing skills** due to high stakeholder visibility.
This role acts as a **bridge between business, product, and implementation teams**, translating business needs into scalable, high-performance payment solutions. The individual is expected to be an **effective leader, mentor, and thought leader**, contributing to future-ready payment architectures and strategies.
The role combines **functional design leadership, solution selling, and client-facing engagement**, requiring deep working knowledge of payments and modern distributed system architectures.
Your future duties and responsibilities
ead techno-functional design and solution definition for complex payment systems, translating business requirements into scalable and resilient solutions
Act as a bridge between business, product, and engineering teams, ensuring alignment across requirements, design, and implementation
Drive requirement elicitation, analysis, and documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, process flows, data/message mappings, and user stories
Own end-to-end functional design for payment flows, including initiation, validation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
Define and review functional decomposition aligned to microservices and domain-driven design principles
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure functional designs align with technical architecture (such as microservices, MQ or Kafka-based event flows, database modelling, UI design etc.).
Validate functional designs against non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, resiliency, security, and regulatory compliance
Support Development, FAT, UAT and implementation phases, including scenario definition, validation support, and issue analysis.
Provide functional guidance during production issue analysis and root cause investigations, especially for payment failures and reconciliation breaks.
Engage directly with clients and senior stakeholders, presenting designs, explaining solution options, and influencing design decisions
Contribute to solution selling and pre-sales activities, including proposal support, solution walkthroughs, and client discussions.
Mentor junior designers and analysts, promoting best practices and thought leadership in payments design.
Contribute to future-state architecture and product roadmap discussions, incorporating industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies.
Ensure all functional artifacts are accurate, complete, and audit-ready, supporting operational and compliance needs.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and cross-team design reviews.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must-Have Skills:
General / Functional Skills
* Proven experience in **product development** with strong focus on **techno-functional design, decomposition, and solution definition**
* Strong **UML modeling skills**, preferably using **Sparx Enterprise Architect**
* Ability to understand, analyze, and document **business requirements** from diverse stakeholders
* Expertise in **Business Analysis**, **Requirement Elicitation**, **Gap & Impact Analysis**, **Message/Data Mapping**, and **FAT validation**
* Experience producing **BRDs, Functional Specifications, Process Flow Diagrams, User Stories, Backlogs**, and related artifacts
* Excellent **written and verbal communication skills**
* Strong **client-facing experience**, including interaction with senior executives (internal and external)
* Solid understanding of **technical aspects of software products**, including:
* Interfaces & APIs
* Connectivity & integration patterns
* Databases
* Application servers & middleware
* SOA and distributed systems
* Data warehousing, archival, and purge strategies
* Hands-on experience across the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
* Strong working knowledge of **Agile delivery models**
Payments Domain Expertise
* Extensive experience in **payments-related software development projects or products**
* Strong proficiency in **SWIFT**, **SWIFT GPI**, **NACHA**, **CHAPS**
* Hands-on experience with **Clearing & Settlement Systems** across **Europe, Canada, and the US**
* Experience working with **at least two clearing systems in different countries**
* Proven track record of **product or project implementation** in **medium to large-scale banks**
Architecture & Technology (Key Additions)
* Strong **working knowledge of Microservices Architecture**, including:
* Service decomposition and domain-driven design concepts
* API-driven integration and service orchestration
* Working knowledge of designing interfaces.
* Resilience, scalability, and fault-tolerance considerations in payment systems
* Performance optimization and high availability considerations
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams to ensure **functional designs align with scalable, performant system architectures**
Good-to-Have Skills:
* Experience with **SWIFT Service Bureau** implementations
* Exposure to **product roadmap planning** and **DevOps strategies**
* Site implementation experience with leading payment products such as **Fundtech** or **Clear2Pay**
* Experience representing organizations in **external forums, industry panels, or conferences**
* Strong understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and operational readiness for payment platforms**

12. Full cycle experience in SAP Migration and S/4 Conversion activities.
13. Strong knowledge and exposure to HANA Database and MS SQL Database.

15. Proficient in the use of methodologies supported by SAP best practices.
16. Strong knowledge in troubleshooting performance issues and providing solutions to fine tune the system.
17. Must be proactive and self-motivated.
18. Must be easily understood and possess excellent English communication skills, both verbal and writing skills.

20. Exposure to ITIL framework.

Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.

Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.

Zero Regulatory Deviations

Working knowledge of CRM systems

Role & responsibilities
Requirement - Business Analyst
Hexagram FinTech, a products company in the Investment Management space is looking for young and energetic Functional Specialists to supplement the current product team. The product is deployed in several of the top mutual fund and insurance companies in India and South East Asia and will expose you to the capital markets in these regions.

• Assisting the product development team in Testing and validation of functionality
• Providing support to existing clients on the products
• As part of Implementation, will be responsible for supporting the users in user acceptance tests, conducting user training, coordinating with Technical teams, documenting user requirements, assisting in data reconciliation and reporting
• Manage releases from the product team to the client installations, conduct detailed tests, contributing to continuous enrichment of user guides / manuals
• Ability to work as per clients working hours.
Educational Background: Graduate / Post Graduate in Finance
Should be either from BA background or accounting background.
Experience in Front/ Mid /Back end roles on Investment System is a plus.

Hi,
Key Responsibilities
Soft Services Operations
Oversee housekeeping operations and ensure cleanliness standards are maintained across the facility.
Manage pantry, cafeteria, and employee amenity services.
Coordinate pest control, waste management, and hygiene-related activities.
Ensure smooth functioning of reception and front-office services.
Conduct regular facility inspections and implement corrective actions wherever required.
Vendor Management
Supervise and manage soft service vendors and contractual manpower.
Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels (SLAs).
Validate attendance, billing, and invoicing of service partners.
Ensure adequate staffing and grooming standards among vendor personnel.
Client & Occupant Management

Ensure timely closure of service requests and complaints.
Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and drive customer satisfaction.
Conduct workplace experience initiatives and engagement activities.
Compliance & Safety

Maintain records related to housekeeping audits, pest control, waste disposal, and statutory compliance.
Support emergency preparedness and business continuity initiatives.
Reporting & Administration
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
Track service performance metrics and improvement actions.
Manage inventory of housekeeping and pantry consumables.
Support budget monitoring and cost-control initiatives.

Desired Candidate Profile
Education
Graduate in any discipline.
Diploma/Certification in Facility Management will be an added advantage.
Experience
Experience in Facility Management, Administration, Hospitality, or Soft Services Operations.
Experience managing corporate offices, commercial buildings, IT parks, or multinational client facilities preferred.
Skills Required
Strong knowledge of housekeeping and soft service operations.
Vendor and team management experience.
Customer-centric approach with excellent communication skills.
Good understanding of workplace safety and compliance requirements.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Key Competencies
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail.
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.
High level of ownership and accountability.

Description:
Customer Service Executive
Department: Customer Support
Company: NoBroker.com
Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
About the Role
Are you passionate about helping customers and providing excellent service? Join NoBroker as a Customer Service Executive and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to delivering a seamless customer experience. In this role, you will assist customers with their queries, provide appropriate solutions, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through effective communication and timely support.
About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is India's first PropTech unicorn. It is a brokerage-free real estate platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for intermediaries. With a strong customer base across major Indian cities, NoBroker is transforming the real estate industry through technology-driven solutions and customer-focused services.
Specific Responsibilities
Customer Support: Handle inbound and outbound customer calls and assist customers with their queries and concerns.
Query Resolution: Understand customer issues and provide accurate, timely, and effective solutions.
Customer Relationship Management: Build positive customer relationships through professional and courteous communication.
Service Excellence: Ensure a smooth customer experience while maintaining high service quality standards.
Follow-ups: Contact customers when required to provide updates, resolve pending queries, and ensure customer satisfaction.
Issue Escalation: Identify complex issues and escalate them to the appropriate team for resolution.
Customer Feedback: Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the overall service experience.
Performance Goals: Meet defined targets related to call quality, customer satisfaction, productivity, and resolution time.
Documentation: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, queries, and resolutions in the company's systems.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers
Education: HSC (12th pass) or graduate candidates can apply.
Communication Skills: Good verbal communication and active listening skills.
Language Requirements: Candidates must be proficient in English and Hindi, along with one of the following regional languages:
Profile 1: English + Hindi + Kannada
Profile 2: English + Hindi + Telugu
Customer Service Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, patience, empathy, and a customer-first attitude.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to handle customer queries professionally and maintain positive customer relationships.
Technical Skills: Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office are preferred.
Work Schedule: Comfortable working 6 days a week, with one weekday off.
Shift Timing: Flexible to work a 9-hour shift scheduled between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM.
Perks & Value Proposition
Health Insurance: Company-paid health insurance coverage of 1 lakh per year.
Career Growth: Opportunities for internal career progression based on performance.
Promotions: Regular performance reviews, with promotions every six months and accelerated opportunities for outstanding performers, as per company policy.
Rewards & Recognition: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Team-Building Activities: Regular team events and an annual outing.
Why NoBroker?
At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to grow professionally while delivering exceptional customer experiences. Join a collaborative and fast-paced work environment where your communication skills, customer-focused approach, and problem-solving abilities can make a real difference.
Apply today and take the next step in your career with NoBroker!
AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Inside Sales Executive
Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!
Location
:
:
:
Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Full-time
Position Type
Salary Range
Up to 4.5 LPA to 5.5 LPA (inclusive of variable components

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.
Sales and Relationships: Build strong client relationships and effectively
communicate product value.
Problem Solving: Address client challenges with tailored solutions.
Lead Management: Handle outbound calls and follow-ups to nurture leads and
drive conversions.
Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!
Location
:
:
:
Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Full-time
Position Type
¢ Salary Range
Up to 4.5 LPA to 5.5 LPA (inclusive of variable components

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.
Sales and Relationships: Build strong client relationships and effectively
communicate product value.
Problem Solving: Address client challenges with tailored solutions.
Lead Management: Handle outbound calls and follow-ups to nurture leads and
drive conversions.
Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Description:
Client Advisor Job Description

About NoBroker

NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting
experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership,
customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.

About the Role

We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales,understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBrokers products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBrokers plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.

Candidate Requirements

Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.• Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Why Join NoBroker?
Opportunity to build a career in a fast-paced PropTech environment.
Performance-driven growth opportunities.
Exposure to sales, customer management, negotiation, and business development.

NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech

and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh

billion.

Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.

Perks & Value Proposition:

Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted annually, with outstanding

About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---

 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement

* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.

Company Name: Manipal Hospitals
Job Title: Technician-Microbiology

Job Description:
The Technician-Microbiology will be responsible for performing a variety of laboratory procedures related to the analysis and testing of microbiological samples. This role involves collecting samples, preparing cultures, conducting tests, and interpreting results in accordance with established protocols. The technician will also maintain laboratory equipment, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and assist in research projects as needed. Effective communication and collaboration with other healthcare professionals are essential to ensure accurate diagnosis and treatment plans.

Key Responsibilities:
- Collect and prepare microbiological samples for analysis.
- Conduct microbiological tests on various specimens such as blood, urine, swabs, and other samples.
- Interpret test results and document findings accurately.

Customer Service Executive

Department: Customer Servicing

Are you a people-first individual who enjoys helping customers and solving problems? Join our team at NoBroker as a Customer Service Executive and be the trusted voice that helps our customers through their property journey!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.05 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us

NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long-term engagement.
Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 3–4 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer service process.
Understand customer needs and assist in resolving queries and finding the right tenant or property, with a strong focus on customer experience rather than hard sales targets.
Provide regular, proactive updates on account/service progress and utilize internal tools while adhering to company guidelines for high-quality service delivery.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer satisfaction; performance is monitored though the role is not heavily target-based.

Perks & Value Proposition

Performance incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of up to 15,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, HSC (12th) or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: 6-day working week — Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Why NoBroker?
At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape. Take the next step in your career and apply today!

AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

JOB TITLE: Recruiter Level 1
LOCATION: Bangalore, Karnataka
JOB DESCRIPTION:
If you have the passion to work with people and are excited by the thought of collaborating with an
international audience, making a difference in peoples lives around the world, and of course growing your
career in the HR Recruitment space, you should interview with us.
JOB SUMMARY:
The key focus for a Recruiter is to execute sourcing strategies and plans with a focus on passive candidates,
with the aim of achieving high quality, cost-effective and timely filling of roles. You will work closely with the
Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders to recommend and develop a sourcing strategy. Based
on your experience, you will recommend enhancements to ensure recruitment strategy effectiveness and
will initiate and drive best-practice sourcing strategies
Your duties may include, but are not limited to:
Responsible for identifying talent that meets specific client requirements.
Build a strong working relationship with Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders.
¢ Understanding & analyzing the requirement of the position based on clients specifications.
¢ Utilize a variety of recruiting strategies to focus on direct sourced (passive) candidates.
¢ Involved in sourcing profiles through job portals, internal databases, and professional networking.
¢ Utilize the internal database to identify potential candidates and post jobs on the portals to increase
the pool of candidates.
¢ Call potential candidates in the US and discuss the job openings.
¢ Provide exceptional candidate care and ensure that candidates are effectively pre-screened before.
¢ Select and qualify candidates based on skill, cultural, and motivational fit, utilizing behavioral-based
Approach and screening criteria.
¢ Maintain timely and accurate information on all candidate interactions.
¢ Proactively pipeline talent and create pre-qualified candidate talent pools in line with the clients.
QUALIFICATION:
¢ Bachelors/Masters degree. (For recent under-graduates: They should have all the semesters
original mark sheets. No active backlogs)



¢ The average of 10th, 12th (PUC), and UG marks percentage should be more than 60%.
¢ Ability to learn and adapt to working on newer skills and requirements demands.
¢ Possess strong written and oral English communication skills.
¢ Ability to recruit with a sense of urgency.
¢ Availability to work before/after typical office hours as work may necessitate.
¢ A strong work ethic and sense of commitment.
¢ Ability to work under pressure and target-driven environment.
WORK SCHEDULE:
Night Shift Should be flexible to work on both shift

Data Analyst
Location: Mumbai, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Bangalore, India
Job Type: Full Time


About the Role
MitKat Advisory is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Analyst who is responsible for managing end-to-end security data collection, governance, integration, and operational analytics across assigned service locations. The position centralizes and validates data streams from physical security systems, dashboards, and logbooks to build real-time automated visualizations, conduct predictive modeling, and track program costs. By identifying trends and operational vulnerabilities, the Data Analyst delivers actionable, data-driven insights to optimize tactical resources, improve response capabilities, and support executive decision-making.


Key Responsibilities
Centralize, clean, and validate data streams at service locations from physical security systems, including Access Control, CCTV, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Incident Management Systems.
Aggregate data from security service provider dashboards, logbooks, registers, and digital feeds.
Conduct operational data collection as required by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compile security operational reports.
Establish data hygiene processes to guarantee security data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with corporate privacy standards.
Design, build, and maintain real-time automated operational dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Track key performance indicators (KPIs) across Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT) deployments, equipment readiness, and incident response times.
Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual security operational reports analyzing security trends, site-level risks, and resource utilization across locations.
Perform variance analysis comparing actual deployments and equipment costs against maximum Statement of Work (Scope of Services) caps and monthly baseline targets.
Analyze physical security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, and asset loss logs to identify emerging security trends and operational vulnerabilities.
Deliver data-driven recommendations for optimal CIRT operator headcount, hardware, and tactical gear allocation across regions.


Required Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
Certifications (Preferred): Professional certifications in BI tools (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Desktop Specialist) or data management.


Preferred Attributes
Practical experience in data aggregation, data hygiene, governance, and statistical analysis.
Experience designing and maintaining interactive dashboards using industry-standard visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Hands-on experience performing financial variance analysis, cost tracking, and operational metric modeling.
Experience handling operational data streams, incident log analysis, or physical security metrics
Strong knowledge of data governance principles, data hygiene practices, and corporate privacy compliance standards.
Familiarity with predictive modeling techniques, trend analysis, and pattern identification methodologies.
Understanding of operational performance metrics, resource utilization analysis, and budget variance tracking.
Basic understanding of physical security technology systems (Access Control, CCTV, IDS, and Incident Management Systems).
Data Visualization BI: Advanced proficiency in building real-time dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
Data Cleansing Governance: Capability to integrate, validate, and sanitize disparate physical and digital data logs.
Financial Cost Analytics: Proficiency in performing cost variance analysis against baseline targets and Scope of Services budget caps.
Technical Writing Reporting: Ability to draft clear, error-free operational reports summarizing trends and strategic recommendations.
Analytical Thinking: Translates raw, multi-source data into structured, predictive insights and actionable operational strategies.
Data Integrity Precision: High attention to detail ensuring complete accuracy, hygiene, and confidentiality across all reports and dashboards.
Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies operational vulnerabilities, process enhancements, and system optimization opportunities.
Stakeholder Alignment: Communicates complex analytics effectively to support operational leaders and vendor management teams.

Description:
HUMAN RESOURCE
HR Business Partner
Assistant Manager / Manager
Bengaluru • On-site | 14 years; fresh graduates may apply
Individual contributor | Reporting to CHRO / Head – HRBP
The opportunity
Partner with leaders, managers and employees to strengthen employee experience, improve retention and turn business priorities into practical people initiatives.
What you will do
Business strategy: Translate growth, expansion, productivity and organisational change priorities into workforce, capability and people plans.
Business partnering: Understand team objectives and workforce challenges; work with leaders to deliver effective people plans.
Engagement: Run listening sessions, pulse surveys and engagement initiatives; turn feedback into measurable action plans.
Retention & attrition: Analyse trends, conduct stay and exit conversations, identify root causes and support targeted retention actions.
Query resolution & employee relations: Resolve employee questions and concerns promptly, with discretion, documentation and appropriate escalation.
Performance management: Support goal setting, reviews, feedback and performance improvement plans with fair, consistent processes.
Workforce planning: Partner with leaders and TA on headcount needs, capability gaps, hiring priorities and internal mobility.
HR analytics: Track headcount, attrition, engagement and performance; turn people data into recommendations for leadership.
Employee lifecycle: Support smooth onboarding, employee transitions and exits.
What you will bring
Completed full-time MBA/PGDM in HR, MA in HRM & Labour Relations or equivalent relevant postgraduate qualification from a Tier 1 institute, such as XLRI Jamshedpur, TISS Mumbai or MDI Gurgaon’s HR programme.
1–4 years in HRBP, business HR or an HR generalist role. Fresh graduates with relevant HR internships or projects may also apply.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills; confidence with Excel and HR dashboards.
Empathy, ownership, confidentiality and sound judgement, with the ability to balance employee needs and business priorities.
ENGAGE PEOPLE. BUILD CAPABILITY. SUPPORT BUSINESS PERFORMANCE.

Description:
Tele Sales Executive

Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.
Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.
Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.
Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.
Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition

Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal communication, strong negotiation and persuasion skills, target-driven mindset, and good interpersonal skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort using CRM/calling tools.
Work schedule: 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Age: 18 - 30
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints

a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests

Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.
Key Skills & Requirements: Educational Qualification Graduation in Mass Communication, Marketing, Fashion, or any relevant field. Experience 1-3 years in anchoring, live streaming, or social media hosting (jewellery or fashion industry preferred). Skills Required
Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura

Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and

Graduate in any discipline.

AboutCompany:
Mission: Make India's billion-plus households financially safe and secure

Values: Fairness to all our stakeholders

Vision: A healthy and well-protected India

PolicyBazaar.com is India's largest insurance marketplace and a leading fintech player globally. It has backing from a host of investors including the likes of SoftBank, InfoEdge (Naukri.com), Temasek, Tiger global Management, True North, Premji Invest. The portal started in 2008 with a purpose to educate people on insurance products and has had a significant influence on how insurance is bought in India. It has helped in driving penetration of pure life insurance, health insurance, and such products which were barely bought earlier. From receiving traffic of 180,000 visitors in 2008, PolicyBazaar.com has come a long way and today hosts over 100 million visitors yearly, and records 10 transactions on its platform every minute. The company collected Rs 3,500 cr of insurance premium in FY19, and is on track to double this figure in FY20.
PolicyBazaar.com accounts for nearly 25% of India's life cover, and over 7% of Indias retail health business. It accounts for roughly half of all internet based insurance purchase in the country.

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.
