Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.

Description:
Associate, Program Implementation [Tripura]
Tripura, Fluency in Hindi, English and Bengali
Supports the on-ground implementation and monitoring of Labhyas Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) program in partnership with the state government. Ensures high-quality delivery through effective coordination, capacity building, data management, and stakeholder engagement.
Role Expectations
All the tasks mentioned below would be key to your role. The following requirements are not mentioned in order of priority.
Manage a dedicated team of Field Supervisors in the state with respect to reporting, coordination, training, data completion, and any need-based support.
Conduct regular field visits to monitor program implementation and ensure adherence to guidelines and timelines.
Regularly review field team performance, provide feedback, and build their capacity through ongoing coaching and mentoring.
Troubleshoot challenges in real-time, escalate issues when necessary, and ensure timely resolution.
Oversee program implementation across assigned districts, ensuring that program milestones, quality benchmarks, and timelines are consistently met.
Work closely with the Monitoring Evaluation (ME) team to ensure effective implementation of program activities and high-quality data collection from the field.
Contribute to the creation of performance dashboards and reports for internal reviews and decision-making.
Develop teaching and learning materials focused on Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) for different grades or contexts.
Design and facilitate online and in-person training and capacity-building sessions for enumerators, teachers, and other stakeholders.
Conduct refresher training and follow-up learning circles to reinforce capacity building and improve delivery quality.
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree in Education, Social Science, or a related field.
Experience
1-2 years of proven experience in teacher training, facilitation, or program implementation.
Prior experience in on-ground or field-based roles is preferred.
Exposure to training facilitation, monitoring, or stakeholder coordination will be an advantage.
Understanding of Social Emotional Learning (SEL), mental health, or child psychology is preferred.
Characteristics
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Bengali (non-negotiable).
Knowledge of other regional dialects in Tripura will be preferred.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and coordination skills.
Excellent organisational and time management abilities.
Proficient in Google Tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and comfortable with digital reporting systems.
Highly motivated, empathetic, and driven by childrens wellbeing.
A self-starter who acts with urgency, takes initiative, and learns quickly.
Comfortable with regular travel across districts for field visits, training, and coordination.
Open to experimentation, collaboration, and feedback in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment.
Deeply committed to integrity, transparency, and trust in both process and relationships.
If youre someone who is driven by purpose, excited to build, and energized by working closely with communities in service of childrens wellbeing, wed love to hear from you. We care more about your drive, alignment, and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

The Executive – Sales is responsible for driving business growth in the territory by managing dealer and sub-dealer networks, achieving sales and collection targets, strengthening market presence, and ensuring effective execution of company strategies.
3. Key Deliverables / Responsibilities
Manage and expand channel distribution
Appoint, develop, and monitor dealers and authorized sub-dealers
Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets
Ensure availability of products and correct market pricing
Execute brand-building and promotional activities at local level
Conduct mason/contractor meets and provide technical support
Ensure timely collection and healthy fund flow from dealers
Track competitor activity and provide market intelligence
Maintain accurate sales reports, MIS, and forecasts
4. Key Result Areas (KRA) & Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
KRA 1: Sales Target Achievement
Monthly, quarterly, and annual volume & value target achievement
Growth in secondary sales and repeat business
KRA 2: Channel Development
Appointment of new dealers and sub-dealers
Improvement in dealer productivity and coverage
KRA 3: Market Development & Visibility
Increased market share in Sivasagar region
Execution of branding, visibility, and promotional activities
KRA 4: Collection & Credit Control
Timely collection as per credit norms
Reduction of overdue and outstanding balances
KRA 5: Compliance & Reporting
Adherence to company pricing, schemes, and SOPs
Timely reporting of sales, collections, and market feedback
5. Roadmap of Success
0–3 Months
Understand company products, pricing, and sales processes
Map Sivasagar market, dealer base, and competitor landscape
Build strong relationships with dealers and influencers
3–6 Months
Achieve minimum 85–90% of assigned sales targets
Expand sub-dealer network in uncovered areas
Improve product visibility and secondary sales
6–12 Months
Consistently achieve or exceed targets
Strengthen dealer loyalty and market share
Become a key contributor to regional business growth

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

SELLER BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE (BDA)
Job Description | Field Sales
CompanyNoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.LocationBangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, PuneExperienceMinimum 1 year and smart freshersWork ModeFull-time | Field-basedLanguagesEnglish / Kannada English / Telugu English / Tamil English / Hindi ¢ English / MarathiCore Focus: Field Sales
ROLE SUMMARY
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property features, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate pricing between buyers and sellers to close deals.
Onboard property owners and encourage premium service subscriptions where applicable.
Visit commercial properties to collect owner details and explain NoBroker services.
Upload property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.
ELIGIBILITY
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory
Smart freshers / Experience up to 2 years in field sales.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
Bike and valid Driving License.
Smartphone.
Candidates should be comfortable communicating in at least one of the required language combinations: English/Kannada, English/Telugu, English/Tamil, or English/Hindi.
PREFERRED SKILLS
Field Sales ¢ Business Development ¢ Lead Generation ¢ Customer Relationship Management (CRM) ¢ Negotiation ¢ Client Acquisition ¢ Relationship Building ¢ Sales Closing ¢ Site Visits ¢ Communication Skills ¢ Target Achievement ¢ Time Management
READY TO BUILD YOUR CAREER IN REAL ESTATE SALES?
Join a field-driven role where you will engage property owners and customers, conduct site visits, and contribute directly to successful property transactions.

Role: Workday Compensation Consultant
Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.

Description:
We're looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to lead API quality for a Spring Boot microservices platform hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You'll design, build, and maintain scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured or Karate, and BDD practices, while integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
In this role, you'll collaborate with developers, product teams, architects, and integration partners to shape testable designs, identify quality risks, and ensure services meet functional, performance, and security standards. You'll help define QA strategy and team practices, manage test cases and execution using Jira and Xray, and use AI-enabled tools to support test design, automation, and analysis.
The ideal candidate brings strong Java and API testing expertise, experience with Spring Boot, cloud-native technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, and GCP, plus familiarity with Agile delivery, databases, Git, and CI/CD tools. Knowledge of API security, contract or performance testing, monitoring tools, and eCommerce is an advantage. A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
1. Leadership and Strategy
Develop and execute a comprehensive API automation strategy aligned with the organization's quality goals.
Identify and introduce innovative testing approaches, tools, and technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of QA processes.
Stay current with trends in API automation, AI-assisted testing, and cloud-native testing, and apply them where they add value.
Promote a culture of quality ownership and accountability within the team.
2. API Automation Development
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured (or Karate), and BDD principles (Cucumber/Gherkin).
Write clean, well-documented, maintainable automation scripts to validate API functionality, performance, and security.
Implement data-driven testing strategies to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI) for continuous testing.
Build reusable frameworks and integrate SaaS frameworks to improve scalability and efficiency.
Perform API testing and exploration with tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI.
Apply API security testing principles (for example, OWASP) and validate data quality, including with large datasets.
3. AI-Enabled Testing
Use a range of AI models in day-to-day testing, including generating test cases and identifying test scenarios.
Set up and configure AI agents to automate testing tasks and speed up test design, execution, and analysis.
Evaluate new AI models and tools, and recommend how the team should adopt them.
4. Test Management with Jira and Xray
Create, organize, and maintain test cases in Xray.
Integrate Xray with Jira to provide traceability between requirements, tests, executions, and defects.
Build and manage test catalogs and test sets in Xray.
Plan and track test execution and report results in Jira and Xray.
Keep test plans, procedures, scripts, results, and configuration documented in Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira.
5. Collaboration and Communication
Work with developers, product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure testability.
Participate in design and architecture reviews to give feedback on testability and flag quality risks early.
Work with extended integration partner teams to define and execute exploratory and automated API tests.
Communicate test results and quality metrics to stakeholders clearly and concisely.
Take part in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to product design and architecture discussions.
6. Quality Assurance and Best Practices
Establish and enforce QA guidelines, best practices, and standards across the team.
Review code actively to ensure software quality and functional accuracy.
Ensure all code follows secure coding practices and maintains code coverage of at least 70%.
Write and maintain unit tests with JUnit or TestNG where applicable.
7. Coding and Development
Complete coding tasks to design specifications, with high quality and on schedule.
Work under the guidance of a Technical Architect and contribute to the overall system design.
Use Git and collaboration platforms such as GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab for version control and code reviews.
8. Cloud and Platform Testing
Validate microservices built with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, including RESTful APIs and dependency-injection-based components.
Test services deployed on GCP (for example, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions), using Docker and Kubernetes environments.
Validate data in relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).
9. Operational Support
Handle operational issues with minimal oversight, and troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly.
Use monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to diagnose issues where available.
10. Nice-to-Have Contributions
Implement contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks.
Run performance tests with JMeter or Gatling.
Apply eCommerce domain knowledge to improve test scenarios and coverage.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience
8-12 years of experience in software development and quality assurance, with a strong focus on API automation.
Experience working in Agile teams and taking part in sprint ceremonies.
API Automation
Extensive hands-on experience with RestAssured for API testing.
Proficiency in BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/Gherkin.
Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI.
Knowledge of API security testing principles and tools (for example, OWASP).
Experience designing data-driven tests and building reusable automation frameworks.
AI Tools and Automation
Familiarity with a range of AI models and their strengths.
Comfortable using AI models in day-to-day testing, including creating test cases and identifying test scenarios.
Experience setting up AI agents for test automation.
Java and Spring Boot
Strong proficiency in Java and related open-source technologies.
Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud for building microservices.
Working knowledge of dependency injection, RESTful APIs, and other core Spring concepts.
Cloud Technologies
Solid understanding of cloud-native technologies and architectures.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions.
Testing Frameworks and Tools
Experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and TestNG.
Proficiency with IDEs such as Eclipse or IntelliJ IDEA.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
Test Management (Jira and Xray)
Strong working knowledge of Jira and Xray.
Experience creating test cases in Xray and integrating Xray with Jira.
Experience creating test catalogs and test sets in Xray.
Experience using Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira for documentation, scripts, results, and configuration.
Databases and Data Quality
Basic knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).
Experience with data quality testing and working with large datasets.
Version Control and Collaboration
Proficiency with Git.
Experience with GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab.
Quality and Secure Coding
Ability to follow secure coding practices and maintain code coverage of at least 70%.
Experience reviewing code for quality and functional accuracy.
Experience writing and maintaining test plans, procedures, and scripts.
Soft Skills
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Eagerness to learn the product's design and architecture and to take part in ceremonies that influence both.
Ability to handle operational issues with minimal oversight.
Nice to Have
Contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks.
Performance testing with JMeter or Gatling.
Monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.
Good understanding of the eCommerce domain.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, Pune and Kolkata

Role & responsibilities

Design and engineer a cloud-native, multi-tenant Apache data platform for on-prem and Azure.
Build platform services and operators using Python for lifecycle automation.
Standardize Kubernetes deployment patterns for Apache stack components (Helm, manifests, policies).
Build and maintain hardened Docker images for all platform runtimes and services.
Architect and operate Spark platform capabilities for batch and streaming workloads.
Implement and maintain Iceberg-based Lakehouse platform foundations and table governance controls.
Build CI/CD platform pipelines in Azure DevOps for automated build, test, release, and rollback.
Implement platform security controls using TLS/SSL, OAuth, RBAC, secrets management, and Vault.
Engineer observability using Prometheus, Grafana, logging pipelines, SLI/SLO dashboards, and alerting.
Lead platform incident response, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and capacity engineering.
Partner with security, compliance, and consuming teams to onboard workloads and enforce enterprise standards along with CVE remediation

Preferred candidate profile

Strong full-stack engineer with deep expertise in Python REST APIs, Kubernetes.
Advanced Python scripting and automation for platform provisioning, validation, and operational runbooks.
Deep Kubernetes expertise (scheduling, networking, storage, security, scaling, troubleshooting).
Hands-on Docker expertise for image lifecycle, hardening, and runtime optimization.
Expert Apache Spark platform knowledge (cluster tuning, job isolation, batch + streaming)
Strong Apache Iceberg platform understanding (catalogues, partitioning, compaction, governance).
CI/CD engineering using Azure DevOps, including policy-driven release controls.
Strong observability and reliability engineering using Prometheus and Grafana.

Description:
Business Information:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 2300 skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement:
Understand and apply project documentation and execution practices in accordance with internal project control standard procedures/instructions in system.
Your Responsibilities:
Ensure adherence to quality standards, create reports, and provide analysis using project document trackers.
Should have experience in reading customer contracts and understand the project documentation requirements. Working knowledge with EMDS.
Analyze & upload Engineering and Supplier documents (new and revised) for Tender / Project into the DMS or common drive.
Create and control Document Registers and analyze & upload Engineering and Supplier documents (new and revised) for Tender / Project into the DMS or common drive.
Communicate with Project Manager and Departments for Clarifications and Suggestions
Handling Customer commented/approved documents in DMS and informing Project team.
Adding the documents into web-based database, for easy access for the members in different locations
Prepare the publishing documents packages for printing (hard copies), if needed.
After Customer Approval of project's final documents, hand over the Project to After Sales Department.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background:
Non-Engineering - A diploma or bachelor's/master's degree.
5 to 8 years of experience as a document controller.
Proficiency in MS-Office Applications (Word, PPT and Excel).
Strong communication skills in written and verbal (English).
Capability to work with multi-cultural and multilingual users.
Quick learner, Proactive, Self-Motivated, and Flexible.

PERFECT PLACER (www.perfectplacer.com), Promoted by a team of dedicated professionals with varied background, having comprehensive and extensive industry and consultancy exposure, is “One of the most preferred and referred consultants” today in Executive Search & Placement.

PERFECT PLACER in less than half a decade has grown to be a force to reckon with, having offices in Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, and New Delhi.

Perfect Placer along with its associate services has a long and prestigious list of leading Indian and Multinational Corporates in India and Outside across Managerial levels, functions, and Industries, covering both IT and Non-IT specialized in chief executive, board member and senior-level management search assignments.

Sales Manager - Engineering Plastics Non-Auto
You are responsible for business-to-business (B2B) sales and market expansion for high-performance polymers (such as PC, PBT, PET, ABS, PMMA, PA, PP, ASA, PET, Nylon, Poly and POM blends) outside the automotive sector.
Key Role Responsibilities
Non-Automotive Application Development:
F Target sectors including electrical and electronics, consumer appliances, industrial machinery, lighting, packaging, and medical/healthcare.
F Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to negotiation and order closure.
New Business & OEM Acquisition:
F Identify prospective OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 converters, and processors to pitch custom polymer compounds and engineering resins.
F Forecast sales, develop out of the box sales strategies/models and evaluate their effectiveness.
F Evaluate Customer needs and build productive long-lasting relationships.
F Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify new business opportunities.
F Achieve monthly and annual sales targets while ensuring high customer satisfaction.
Technical & Commercial Coordination:
F Bridge the gap between R&D/technical teams’ production, planning, quality and procurement departments to run material trials, sample approvals to ensure timely execution of customer orders and volume negotiations
F Prepare sales forecasts, MIS reports, and pipeline updates for management review.
Key Account Management:
F Manage distributor networks, handle pricing/forecasting, and track accounts receivable (A/R).
F Research accounts and generate of follow through sales leads.
F Meet personal and team sales target.
F Report and provide feedback to management using financial statistical data.
F Maintain and expand client database within your assigned territory.
F Conduct customer visits, product presentations, and technical discussions to promote packaging solutions.
F Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and finalize contracts while maintaining company profitability.

Preferred candidate profile
1. BE or BSc with 5 to 13 years of B2B field sales experience in polymer raw materials, engineering plastics, or masterbatches.
2. Proven track record of handling key accounts and achieving sales targets.
3. Strong B2B sales and business development expertise.
4. Experience in key account management and strategic customer acquisition.
5. Strong commercial acumen and market analysis skills.
6. Familiarity with different sales techniques and pipeline management.
7. Computer literacy including Office Productivity Software - CRM, MS Office, and sales reporting tools etc
Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
8. Self-motivated and driven
9. Knowledge of polymer extrusion/injection molding, strong negotiation skills, and a willingness to travel for client site visits.
10. Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings and business development.

Remuneration:
An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Don't miss out on this opportunity to join the market leader.

Description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
About Applied
Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.
Responsibilities:

As a seasoned Software Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, reliable and maintainable software solutions for our organization.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs.
You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data.
You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers.
Conduct technical reviews and provide guidance to software engineers during the development process.
Identify and mitigate technical risks and issues throughout the software development lifecycle.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements.
Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems.
Mentor and coach Tech Leads & s/w engineers.

Qualifications & Requirements:

12-18 yrs of experience with BTech / MTech in Computer Science.
Proven experience as a Software Architect or similar role with experience of 10+ yrs in product development.
Minimum experience of 10+ years in core Java & advanced features. E.g., streams, functional programming, virtual threads.
Minimum experience of 5+ years in Spring Boot & associated Spring features.
Minimum experience of 4+ years of driving/contributing towards HLD & LLD, contribution towards code reviews & coding practices (like clean code & SOLID principles)
Minimum experience of 4+ years in building and driving microservices based architecture or large-scale systems.
Strong algorithms & data-structures.
Experience in workflow frameworks. Examples - Temporal, Apache Airflow etc.
Experience in reactive programming.

Good to have:

Good knowledge of Semiconductor domain.
Design, prototype, implement and test software and computer vision machine learning algorithms in Python.
Experience with scikit-image, Tensor Flow, PyTorch.

Applied Materials is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

SAP CPI Consultant JD

About the Role

We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.

Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc

Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI, SAP Cloud Platform Integration, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Script, OData Services, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Message Mapping, API Integration, SAP Cloud Platform.
Good to Have Skills
SAP PO/PI, Event Mesh, SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA Integration, Cloud Foundry, API Management, Open Connectors, GitHub, CI/CD, Java.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Description:
Position - Senior Enterprise AI Architect GenAI, Agentic AI & Enterprise Applications
Location : Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai (Hybrid / Work from Office as per project requirement)
Experience : 15–25 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly experienced Enterprise AI Architect who can drive the design and implementation of AI/GenAI solutions across large-scale enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should have experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise business platforms such as:
SAP (S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP AI Core)
Oracle (Oracle ERP, Oracle CX, Oracle Cloud)
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
The role requires a blend of Enterprise Architecture, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, GenAI, Platform Integration, and Business Transformation.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise AI Transformation
Define Enterprise AI strategy and target-state architecture.
Drive AI adoption across enterprise applications and business processes.
Build AI-led transformation roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
Enterprise Platform Integration
Design and implement AI solutions integrated with:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Generative AI & Agentic AI
Architect GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using:
OpenAI
Azure OpenAI
AWS Bedrock
Anthropic Claude
Gemini
Llama
Design autonomous and multi-agent workflows.
Implement enterprise-grade RAG architectures.
AI Solution Architecture
Build scalable and secure AI platforms.
Define reference architectures, governance frameworks, and reusable AI patterns.
Establish LLMOps, MLOps, observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, and Product Owners.
Conduct architecture reviews and technical governance.
Lead client workshops, solutioning discussions, and strategic transformation initiatives.
Must-Have Skills
AI / GenAI
Generative AI
Agentic AI
RAG
LangChain
LangGraph
LLM Integration
Prompt Engineering
AI Governance
Enterprise Platforms (Critical)
Strong hands-on experience in at least one or more:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Cloud Platforms
Azure
AWS
GCP
Architecture
Enterprise Architecture
Solution Architecture
Microservices
API-led Architecture
Cloud-native Design
Preferred Skills
SAP AI Core / SAP BTP
Oracle ERP / Oracle CX
Salesforce AI initiatives
ServiceNow AI integrations
TOGAF Certification
BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, Telecom, Manufacturing experience
AI Center of Excellence leadership
What We Are Looking For
Candidates who have successfully implemented:
AI + SAP
AI + Oracle
AI + Salesforce
AI + ServiceNow
AI + PEGA
rather than profiles that are purely focused on standalone GenAI, Data Science, or AI research.
Summary -
"We are looking for a Senior Enterprise AI Architect who has implemented GenAI/Agentic AI solutions on top of enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, PEGA. The role is focused on enterprise transformation, AI integration, and business process automation rather than standalone AI development."
Detailed Job Description
Position Overview
Tech Mahindra is hiring Senior AI Architects across Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and Bangalore. This role is for senior technology leaders who can define AI architecture strategy, design enterprise-grade solutions, and guide teams from concept to production at scale.
The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on architecture and implementation leadership. It is suited to professionals who can connect business priorities, enterprise platforms, cloud ecosystems, and AI engineering practices into scalable and reusable solution patterns.
Role Purpose
The Senior AI Architect will shape and validate AI-led transformation programs for enterprise clients, with a strong focus on scalable architecture, reusable assets, and outcome-driven solution design. The role is expected to bridge business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, data and AI engineering teams, and delivery leadership across global engagements.
This role requires practical judgment on how AI should be embedded into enterprise landscapes, including business applications, integration layers, governance controls, and production operations. Strong communication with CXOs and cross-functional stakeholders is central to success in this role.
Key Responsibilities
Define target-state AI and data architecture aligned to business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, and transformation roadmaps.
Design end-to-end AI solution architectures covering data pipelines, model development, deployment, monitoring, security, and integration with enterprise applications.
Build scalable and reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, and patterns for enterprise AI adoption.
Evaluate and validate solution options across cloud, AI, and enterprise application platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Lead architecture reviews, technical due diligence, feasibility studies, and proof-of-concept direction for AI initiatives.
Collaborate with business leaders, delivery teams, product owners, security teams, and global stakeholders to shape credible and implementable solutions.
Establish good practices for testing, deployment, observability, lifecycle management, and production support of AI systems.
Drive architectural governance across responsible AI, compliance, privacy, model risk, and enterprise security requirements.
Mentor engineering and architecture teams, influence critical technology choices, and support executive-level solution positioning.
Required Experience
12+ years of overall experience in enterprise technology, architecture, or digital transformation, with strong recent experience in AI/ML solution architecture and delivery.
Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI or ML solutions for enterprise use cases.
Experience across more than one enterprise platform, preferably SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or adjacent enterprise ecosystems.
Experience working in architecture consulting, transformation programs, or complex enterprise modernization engagements.
Demonstrated ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, and multidisciplinary global teams to influence architectural decisions.
Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architecture, security, scalability, and non-functional design principles.
AI And Technical Skills
AI Architecture
End-to-end AI/ML architecture, including data ingestion, feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience with generative AI architecture, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt orchestration, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.
Ability to define reference patterns for recommendation, forecasting, NLP, computer vision, intelligent automation, and enterprise copilots.
Cloud And MLOps
Strong architecture experience on one or more cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Working knowledge of enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices such as experiment tracking, model registry, pipeline orchestration, deployment automation, and model monitoring.
Experience with tools and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow, or equivalent ecosystems.
AI Engineering Stack
Hands-on familiarity with Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools used in enterprise AI delivery.
Understanding of vector databases, knowledge retrieval patterns, API orchestration, agent frameworks, and model integration approaches for production AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services with enterprise applications, data platforms, and middleware layers using secure and scalable design patterns.
Enterprise Platform Expectations
Candidates should bring hands-on architecture or implementation exposure across at least two enterprise platforms or transformation ecosystems. Preferred experience includes SAP BTP or SAP AI capabilities, Oracle enterprise applications and data services, ServiceNow workflow and automation platforms, Salesforce ecosystem integrations, and broader enterprise application modernization patterns.
The role values professionals who can embed AI into enterprise process landscapes rather than treating AI as a standalone lab initiative. Strong grounding in business process transformation, platform interoperability, and enterprise-scale rollout models is important for success.
Leadership And Consulting Skills
Executive presence and the ability to articulate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks, and value realization clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong consulting mindset with structured problem solving, solution framing, estimation support, and transformation roadmap definition.
Ability to lead cross-functional workshops, align distributed teams, and drive decisions in complex, fast-moving programs.
Practical, solution-oriented approach with the confidence to challenge weak designs and strengthen architecture quality before implementation.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required. A master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Preferred Certifications
AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certifications.
AI/ML specialty certifications on major cloud platforms.
Enterprise architecture or platform certifications across SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or related ecosystems.
Work Locations
Hyderabad | Chennai | Pune | Bangalore

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
Required Skills
API Testing
Strong hands-on experience in API Testing.
Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.
API validation using Postman, Swagger, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Basic Auth).
Experience with API automation using Java/Python frameworks.
Automation Testing
Experience in designing and developing automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar frameworks.
Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.
Selenium Automation
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.
Programming Skills
Java or Python programming experience.
Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

The R&D Management Analyst is a key resource providing support to GWE R&D in the management of budget/forecast tracking and inputs to financial systems. The sites will be mostly EMEA and India based. The analyst is a customer facing role in constant liaison with GWE-R&D colleagues, Procurement & Finance teams, suppliers and in country facility managers. The role will provide real added value supporting the delivery of Budget Targets and the reduction in Operating Costs throughout GWE-R&D International.

The R&D Management Analyst responsibilities cover all aspects associated with the Purchasing to Payment (P2P) processes including the raising, monitoring, management and closure of purchase orders in accordance with Pfizer policies and procedures as well as resolving invoice hold and other payment processing issues. The role also encompasses tracking of performance indicators (associated with purchase orders) to support development of efficient process, improved purchasing, supplier order consolidation and continuous improvement.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. - Collaborating with team members to improve financial reporting capabilities
- Assisting in the development of financial management strategies for clients

- Applying financial accounting and reporting standards in client engagements
- Engaging in business process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency
- Utilizing financial modeling and forecasting techniques to support client objectives
- Participating in the administration of financial systems to maintain accuracy and compliance

Location:

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Description:
Join our Team
About this opportunity:
At Ericsson, we re passionate about building software that solves problems. We count on our DevOps Engineers to drive excellence and reliability into our products and services.
As a leader in DevOps, you will lead a team focused on delivering automation and DevOps solutions and implementations in customer NW for 4G and 5G product portfolio for different Business Cases.
What you will do:
- Gather and analyze metrics from both operating systems and applications to assist in performance tuning and fault finding.
- Partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.
- Participate in system design consulting, platform management.
- Create sustainable systems and services through automation and uplifts.
- Balance feature development speed and reliability with well-defined service level objectives
- Rollout automation in customer environment
- Good in troubleshooting during the Live Node Activities
The skills you bring:
Work with the development teams to design scalable, robust systems using cloud native architectural principles.
- Build automation using industry standard tools to deploy hundreds of different services.
- Outstanding collaboration, communication, and innovation skills!
- Develop, manage and maintain automation assets of the Service Delivery Global DevOps Platform
- Develop automation to manage platform infrastructure, applications, and services.
- Continuous improvement of Platform reliability, quality, uptime, and Customer Satisfaction
- Provide primary operational support, lifecycle management, and engineering Platform systems and services.
Required Qualification:
- Git (Must have) GitLab (Preferred) Azure DevOps GitHub Ansible (Must have) Puppet/Chef, Cloudflare (Access), SonarQube (SAST) Docker (Preferred) Artifactory, OSs and Enterprise Environments, Ubuntu 20.04/22.04-RHEL 7/8 (Must have) Kubernetes, Python (Must have) Bash Scripting (Must have) json/yaml.!
- Project management and methodologies
- Scrum, Agile and DevOps ways of working (Preferred)
- Experience with public cloud platforms i.e. Azure, AWS, GCP
- Expertise in DevOps pipeline orchestration and automation
- Experience with common software development tools, such as- Source Code Management, Configuration Management, Security and Compliance, Registries and Artifact Repos, OSs and Enterprise Environments, Desired Programming languages, Monitoring Tools.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.
Why join EricssonAt Ericsson, you ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. You ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Description:
Role & responsibilities


Responsibilities
Client Service
Maintain and build internal and external client relationships by providing exceptional client service
Commit to  proactively connecting and building rapport with both internal and external clients 
Assist with resolving complex client issues and suggest favourable solutions
Invoicing
Maintain client codes in the firms proprietary accounting software based on information provided by the partner and/ormanager .
 Validate the job record billing details and add projects to the job, if required
Confirm invoicing arrangements with the client representative prior to issuing the first invoice to ensure high accuracy
Monitor WIPs, review engagement letters to determine fees to be charged, and liaise with practice managers to capture out of pocket expenses
Draft, finalize, and issue invoices to clients on a timely basis to support achievement of partners’ monthly billing targets 
Reconcile and relieve  related time and expense charges in the firm’s proprietary accounting software 
Liaise with practice managers to ensure internal revenue allocations are agreed in advance and billed as part of the progress billing cycle where applicable
Respond to client queries regarding invoices, including preparation of analyses and preparation of amended invoices when required (as directed by the partner/manager)
Prepare, finalize and issue credit notes 
Prepare bad debt request forms or cash transfer request forms with partner approval
Update and manage billing schedules 
WIP Management 
Prepare monthly detailed analysis of WIP (as required by the partner/manager) to ensure the WIP value reflects what is expected to be recovered in fees from the client. Prepare month-end WIP provisions for review with partner/manager to properly value WIP
Monitor the partner’s overall financial investment, including WIP, A/R and cash collection actuals to target and develop action items to achieve these
Track fees against budgetto confirm proper WIP valuation
Generate reports using the firm’s proprietary accounting software to help monitor a partner’s  engagement economics Advise on unusual WIP activities or budget rates that fall outside of the normal thresholds
Update and maintain billing schedules 
Respond to queries  in relation to engagement financial performance
Prepare and maintain Year-to-Date fee summaries as required
Accounts Receivables
Monitor partners’ monthly cash collection target and actual cash to support achievement of target
Respond to requests from National Finance with respect to cash allocations
Initiate reminders to clients and diligently follow up to ensure timely resolution, as directed by manager/partner
Pull monthly aged A/R reports and review with partner to determine actions required for aging accounts
Work with your manager to escalate outstanding collections with Third Party Collections, as directed bypartner
Maintain A/R notes against the bill record to describe any follow up activities performed 
Review the Electronic Funds Transfer database and post dated cheques log regularly, and action tickets as required


SHIFT:6.30pm-3.30am
