Title: Business Development Manager
Skills: B2B Sales | Business Development | Lead Generation | Logistics Sales | Transportation Sales | Field Sales | Corporate Sales | Client Acquisition | Cold Calling | Customer Relationship Management | Negotiation | Market Development
Description:
Role & responsibilities
Generate new B2B leads and develop business opportunities for logistics and transportation services.
Identify and approach manufacturers, exporters, SMEs, traders, distributors, and other businesses requiring transportation/logistics solutions.
Conduct regular field visits and client meetings to generate new business.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients.
Prospect new customers through cold calling, field visits, references, networking, market research, and other lead-generation activities.
Understand customer transportation requirements and coordinate with the internal team to provide suitable solutions.
Prepare quotations, negotiate with clients, and follow up until business closure.
Achieve monthly/quarterly sales and lead-generation targets.
Develop a strong pipeline of prospective clients and maintain regular follow-ups.
Identify new market segments and business opportunities within the logistics/transportation sector.
Maintain proper records of leads, client meetings, follow-ups, quotations, and conversions.
Monitor competitor activities and market trends.


Preferred candidate profile
2-5 years of experience in Sales / Business Development, preferably in Logistics, Transportation, Freight, Cargo, Supply Chain, or related industries.
Candidates with an existing network among manufacturers, exporters, SMEs, traders, or corporate clients will be preferred.
Strong understanding of B2B sales and lead generation.
Must be comfortable with field sales and regular client visits.
Own vehicle (two-wheeler/car) is mandatory.
Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Self-motivated, result-oriented, and capable of working independently.
Should have a proactive approach toward finding and converting new business opportunities.
Candidates currently working in the logistics/transportation industry are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Skills

B2B Sales | Business Development | Lead Generation | Logistics Sales | Transportation Sales | Field Sales | Corporate Sales | Client Acquisition | Cold Calling | Customer Relationship Management | Negotiation | Market Development



Perks and benefits
Travel Allowance Support for local travel and client visits.
Mobile Allowance Mobile/communication allowance for business-related calls and communication.
Performance-Based Incentives – Additional incentives based on business generation and achievement of targets.
Growth Opportunities – Opportunity to build a career in the logistics and transportation industry.
Learning & Exposure – Direct exposure to B2B sales, client acquisition, and business development.
Supportive Work Environment – Professional and growth-oriented workplace.
AboutCompany:
Aadarsh Transline Co. is a trusted logistics and transportation service provider, serving businesses since 2016. We specialize in providing reliable, efficient, and customer-focused transportation solutions to manufacturers, exporters, SMEs, traders, and other businesses.
With a strong understanding of the transportation industry and B2B logistics requirements, we focus on delivering dependable services, timely execution, transparent communication, and long-term relationships with our clients.
Over the years, we have built our business through professional service, commitment, and strong client relationships. We are continuously expanding our network and looking to build a team of motivated professionals who can contribute to our growth through new business development and client acquisition.
At Aadarsh Transline Co., we believe in long-term partnerships, performance-driven growth, and creating opportunities for our employees to learn, perform, and grow with the company.

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager

Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies

Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick- up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from
a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick-
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance

Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships

Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include
prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards
achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level
of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:Driving NetPromoter Score
Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that
Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring
this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs plan
Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development (Attrition Control)
Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company
training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to
execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management
Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions
are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring
the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision
Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues
are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality
standards
SOP adherence & implementation
Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other
equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Graduate
Ability to act as a link between strategy and execution
Ability to develop and inspire people to achieve their best
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand stated and unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Profile Summary

Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Driving Sales and Customer Service

a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually

b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store

c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership

d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.

e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.

f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.

g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.

h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

Manpower Planning & People Development

a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates

c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.

d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives

e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.

f. Overall responsibility for associate development

Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores

a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level

b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores

c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage

d. Managing the productivity of the staff

e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory

Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations

a. Regular Store Visits to:


Audit stores

Coaching the Store Managers

Motivate staff through sales discussions

Check VM, stock availability

Check store hygiene, grooming

Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.


b. Analyze data before Store Visits


Monitoring Sales through data.

Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores

Store Staffing levels.

Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.

NPS and MC scores

Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets


a. Bridge communication between Management and floor


Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.

Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.

Implementing and enforcing company regulations

Implement process change

Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets


Inventory Management

a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores

b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores

c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores

d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed

e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner

f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level

g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Key Personal and Professional Attributes:

a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.

b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.

c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.

They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.

e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example
Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals
Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals
Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance
Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team
Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns
Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate
Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames

recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Department: Mission SOAR Nagaland
Reports To: Academic Lead
Location: Kohima


Purpose of the Position
Academic Manager will support the Academic Lead in coordinating academic design and capacity-building activities under Mission SOAR Nagaland. The role ensures timely consolidation of inputs from ecosystem partners, government stakeholders, and field educators into actionable frameworks, materials, and training resources. Organisational Unit Function

Coordinate with SCERT, DIETs, and other state institutions for feedback and approvals.
Track design timelines and milestones, ensuring timely delivery of academic outputs.
Manage quality control documentation and review cycles across partners.
Support facilitation of co-design workshops and training sessions.
Organize academic content for dissemination through DIKSHA or other platforms.
Maintain records of academic interventions, iterations, and evidence of impact.
Prepare inputs and updates for governance and reporting processes.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports to the Academic Lead (with dotted-line coordination with the Programs Lead).


Selection Criteria

Essential
Postgraduate degree with 7 years of program/academic coordination experience.
Familiarity with curriculum design, training programs, or education reform.
Strong project management and organisational skills.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination abilities.
Ability to manage timelines and quality assurance processes.
Experience with educational technology platforms is desirable.

Description:
COMPUTER TEACHER JOB DESCRIPTION
Position

Computer Teacher
Responsibilities
Provide quality computer training to students in the assigned school and conduct classes
online when required.
Plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate computer lessons using clear explanations,
demonstrations, activities, and practical sessions.
Conduct regular computer laboratory/practice sessions and guide students through
hands-on exercises.
Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, presentations, worksheets, assignments, and
practice exercises.
Conduct students assessments in a timely manner, including class tests, practical
assessments, assignments, and project work.
Evaluate student performance, provide constructive feedback, and support students who
require additional guidance.
Maintain student assessment data, attendance, records, and documentation of the
programs work in the school.
Use student-centered teaching methods and encourage participation, questioning,
problem-solving, creativity, and practical learning.
Maintain classroom discipline and ensure responsible use of computers, internet
resources, and laboratory equipment.
Conduct classes as per applicable government guidelines and the school’s academic
requirements.
The instructor has to conduct classes at ZPHS.
Support school-level administration of the project and complete project-related work
assigned by the reporting officer.
Coordinate with school staff and the reporting officer regarding schedules, student
progress, assessments, and program activities.
Deliver sessions in English and the official language of the state, as required.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of computer fundamentals, operating systems, file management, and
basic troubleshooting.
Proficiency in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Knowledge of internet usage, email, online safety, digital citizenship, and basic cyber-
safety practices.

Knowledge of coding/programming concepts and ability to teach age-appropriate coding
through languages or platforms such as HTML, CSS, Python, Scratch, or similar tools.
Ability to conduct practical computer laboratory sessions and guide students through
coding and application-based exercises.

Ability to use digital teaching tools, online classrooms, presentations, multimedia
resources, and educational software.
Basic understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, networking concepts, and
common software installation/troubleshooting.
Ability to prepare digital learning materials, assessments, and student-performance data.
Teaching & Classroom Skills
Create structured lesson plans aligned with the prescribed curriculum and
government/school guidelines.
Explain technical concepts in simple, student-friendly language and adapt teaching to
different learning levels.

Use demonstrations, practical exercises, group activities, projects, quizzes, and real-
world examples to make lessons interactive.

Monitor student understanding during lessons and provide timely remedial support.
Manage classroom and computer-lab behavior while promoting a safe, respectful, and
inclusive learning environment.
Track learning outcomes and use assessment results to improve teaching and student
support.
Encourage students to develop logical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, digital
confidence, and responsible technology use.
Qualifications
B. Tech (any branch), MCA, or M.Sc. (Computer Science).
Any graduation with coding training certification.
Candidates with M. Tech / B. Ed. are given preference.
Experience
1+ years of experience in IT training, with familiarity in assessments, evaluation, and
practice sessions.

Location

Nagaland (Wokha)

Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).

Field Enumerators (15 Posts): Position Summary:
We are seeking dedicated and enthusiastic Field Enumerators to conduct baseline assessments for students in primary schools. The successful candidates will visit schools, interact with children to make them feel comfortable, ask assessment questions, and accurately record their responses using a provided tool. This role requires excellent communication skills, proficiency in English, and the ability to use technology effectively. Prior experience working with primary-grade children is highly desirable.

Visit assigned schools to conduct baseline assessments with students.
Create a welcoming and comfortable environment for children to ensure accurate and honest responses.
Ask assessment questions as per the guidelines and record responses using the designated tool.
Ensure accuracy and completeness of recorded data.
Report any issues or inconsistencies encountered during the assessments to the project supervisor.
Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the data collected.
Adhere to the schedule and complete the assessments within the stipulated timeframe.
Utilize technology tools efficiently to record and manage data.
Communicate effectively with school staff and maintain a professional demeanor at all times.
Qualifications/Requirements:
Must have a two-wheeler to travel to conduct the assessments
Proficiency in English (both written and spoken) is a mandatory requirement.
Proficiency in the local language is required.
Basic knowledge and experience in using tech tools and software.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to make children feel at
ease.
Attention to detail and accuracy in data recording.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Flexibility to travel to various school locations as required.
High school diploma or equivalent; higher education in education, psychology, or a
related field is a plus point.

Chozuba Block, Dist. Phek

Qualifications
Graduate above
Requirements
Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
Excellent written and spoken English with strong drafting skills.

Highly organised, trustworthy, discreet, and proactive.

Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods

Full Time

Description:
About Saturday Art Class (SArC):

At Saturday Art Class (SArC), we believe that every child deserves the tools to imagine, express, and grow. As a non-profit educational initiative, we embed visual arts and social-emotional learning (SEL) into the classrooms of India s government and low-income schools-helping children discover their voices and build the skills they need to thrive in life.
Since 2016, SArC has co-created safe and creative spaces with over 90 partners across 13 states , enabling students to engage in art-based learning that nurtures empathy, resilience, and self-awareness. Our digital resources have empowered 1.12 million+ users across 7 countries , reinforcing our commitment to equitable access to creativity and emotional wellbeing.
SArC s journey has been powered by educators, artists, learners, and changemakers who believe in the transformative power of art. Join us as we continue to make creativity a right, not a privilege- for every child, everywhere.

About Manager, Program Operations [Nagaland]:

As the Manager - State Programs (Nagaland) , you will lead SArC s efforts to strengthen and institutionalise Arts within Nagaland s education system . You will lead government partnerships, state-level advocacy, and program implementation to build greater government ownership and sustainable scale.
You will develop and drive the state strategy, build strategic relationships and alliances, lead the Nagaland team, and use evidence and contextual insights to strengthen programs, influence government priorities, and inform organisational strategy.
This role requires a strategic and execution-oriented leader who can navigate complex government systems, influence senior stakeholders, develop teams, and translate program learning into pathways for long-term institutional change.

Roles Responsibilities
1. Government Partnerships State Leadership
Lead strategic engagement with the Directorate of School Education SCERT, Samagra Shiksha, District Education Offices, and other key government stakeholders, building trusted and sustained relationships.
Represent SArC in government reviews, consultations, planning meetings, and relevant state forums, ensuring effective follow-through on commitments and decisions.
Understand government priorities, systems, decision-making processes, and leadership changes to strengthen partnership continuity and identify strategic opportunities.
Serve as the primary bridge between the Nagaland government ecosystem, the state team, and SArC s central team.
2. State Strategy, Advocacy Institutionalisation
Set the state-level strategic direction for strengthening the role of Arts within Nagaland s education system, identifying priorities, opportunities, and pathways for long-term change.
Lead advocacy and influence efforts to build the case for Arts and shape how government stakeholders understand and prioritise its role within education.
Drive the transition from SArC-led programs to sustainable government ownership, identifying opportunities to embed Arts within existing policies, programmes, curricula, teacher development, and systems.
Anticipate changes and risks in the state ecosystem and adapt the strategy to protect and advance long-term institutionalisation.
3. Program Leadership, Monitoring, Learning Knowledge Building
Provide overall leadership for SArC s programs across Nagaland, ensuring quality, consistency, timely delivery, and alignment with the state strategy.
Oversee implementation across educator training, schools, exhibitions, and district and state-level engagements, using field visits to assess quality and understand on-ground realities.
Work with ME to analyse implementation data, stakeholder feedback, and field insights and translate these into program and strategic improvements.
Ensure key implementation learnings, evidence, case studies, and partnership insights are documented and used to strengthen future programming, advocacy, and scale.
4. Team Leadership Cross-Functional Collaboration
Set clear priorities and delegate effectively, enabling the team to take increasing ownership of implementation and stakeholder engagement.
Work closely with Curriculum, Training, Partnerships, ME, Finance, Operations, and Communications to align state priorities with organisational capabilities.
Bring state-level insights and learning into wider organisational strategy and decision-making.
Qualifications Experience:
5-7 years of experience in program management, government partnerships, education programs, or development sector implementation.
Strong understanding of Nagalands education ecosystem and government systems is highly desirable.
Graduate or postgraduate degree in Education, Public Policy, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Management, or a related field.
Proven ability to independently manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
Skills and Mindset:
Strategic Leadership Execution: Ability to translate vision into strategy and effective implementation, with strong planning, prioritisation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Government Stakeholder Leadership: Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to engage, influence, and build trust with senior government and institutional stakeholders.
People Leadership Collaboration: Strong people management skills with the ability to develop high-performing teams, delegate effectively, foster ownership, and collaborate across functions.
Adaptability Ownership: High ownership, resilience, and adaptability, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate risks, respond to changing contexts, and continuously improve. Willingness to travel extensively across Nagaland.
Other Details:
Location: Kohima, Nagaland, India
Compensation: 6 to 7 LPA
Reporting Manager: Chief Operations Officer.

Description:
Join us and build your career in the Modular Kitchen & Home Interiors industry, with opportunities to learn, grow, and be rewarded for your performance.

Experience
Minimum 2 years of experience in Sales, preferably in Direct Sales, Field Sales, or B2C Sales.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets within the assigned/local market.

Key Skills
Strong communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with a team.
Proficiency in English and Hindi, along with at least one regional language.
Strong customer-handling and relationship-management skills.

Preferred Experience
Experience in the Modular Kitchen, Home Interiors, Furniture, Building Materials, or related industries.

Additional Requirements
Own two-wheeler is mandatory for field sales activities.
Willingness to travel within the assigned local market for customer meetings and business development.

Generate new business leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, and market visits.
Identify and develop potential customers within the assigned territory.
Conduct face-to-face meetings to understand customer requirements and present suitable solutions.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales cycle.
Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate products and solutions.
Develop and manage the sales pipeline, ensuring regular follow-ups and timely closures.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, leads, opportunities, and follow-ups.
Negotiate with customers on pricing and commercial terms within approved guidelines.
Consistently work towards achieving monthly and annual sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and contribute to the growth of the assigned market.

Why Join Us?
Opportunity to build a career in the growing Modular Kitchen & Home Interiors industry.
Performance-based incentives in addition to fixed compensation.
Opportunity to develop strong sales and customer-management skills.
Growth opportunities for high-performing individuals.

Interested?
If you are passionate about sales, customer relationships, and business growth, we would love to hear from you.

Share your updated CV at Recruitment@ultrafresh.in or contact us at +91 8655844179 to explore this opportunity.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.

Description:
About Us :
Paytm is Indias leading mobile payments and financial services platform. As the pioneer of mobile QR payments, we empower millions of merchants and consumers to transact digitally. Our mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy using innovative technology.

About the team :
EDC & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the Role :
Were looking for a dynamic Team Leader to drive EDC device sales under the Railway Transit. You will be responsible for managing a team of field executives, driving distribution, and ensuring consistent growth in merchant onboarding and transaction volumes.

Key Responsibilities :
1. Lead and manage a field sales team of 5 or more members
2. Drive EDC machine sales and deployment in the oil & gas sector (e.g., petrol pumps, distributors, etc.)
3. Build and maintain strong channel partner relationships
4. Ensure target achievement through proper team coordination and ground execution
5. Monitor daily productivity, quality of acquisitions, and incentive earnings
6. Train, guide, and motivate team to perform and scale
7. Analyze market trends and competitor activities
8. Regular reporting and MIS handling using Excel and sales tools

Requirements / Expectations :
1. Must have a smartphone, bike, and helmet
2. Minimum 3 years of experience in channel sales & distribution
3. Proven experience in leading field sales teams
4. Strong knowledge of merchant onboarding, incentives, and field sales operations
5. Experience in POS/EDC device sales will be preferred
6. Familiar with metrics-based sales tracking and incentive planning

Education :
Graduate (mandatory); Post-Graduation preferred
