Description:
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations.
Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all ficial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand ficial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Requirement of Pharmacist

BACKGROUND
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.

Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.

GENERAL
Location of Job: Ri Bhoi (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for 1 year, renewable basis performance
No. of Position: 2
Reporting to: Project Coordinator

Job Summary:
Pharmacist will be responsible for preparing and administering appropriate pharmaceuticals to patients. She/he achieves this by executing a physician s order. The job entails a high level of responsibility and knowledge. A pharmacist does not merely hand out prescribed medicine; he/she has the expertise and willingness to assist people and provide them with information and solutions.

1. Duties and Responsibilities:

The key responsibilities of this position are as given below:
Organize the pharmacy in an efficient manner to make the identification of products easier and faster;
Maintain full control over delivering, stocking and labeling medicine and other products and monitor their condition to prevent expiring or deterioration;
Review and execute physician s prescriptions checking their appropriateness and legality;
Listen carefully to customers to interpret their needs and issues and offer information and advice;
Provide assistance other medical services such as injections, blood pressure/ temperature measurements etc.;
Keep records of patient history and of all activities regarding heavy medication;
Comply with all applicable legal rules, regulations and procedures;
Liaoning with other healthcare personnel / medical officers to supply and receive relevant information about the background and progress of patients, as well as to refer order for progress to be made.
Assist the coordinator health/ medical officers during routine mobile OPD / health camps or in time of emergency.
Undertake any other duties assigned time to by Coordinating Office management
2. Other Indicative Requirements

Educational Qualifications
D. Pharma/B. Pharma from a recognized college/university
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)

Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills

We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.

Description:
Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.
Language Mandatory: Excellent written and spoken command of Garo is mandatory. Basic ability to communicate in English and Hindi is preferred.
Key Competencies: Strong community mobilization skills, basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel), and willingness to conduct rigorous field travel.
Logistics: Having a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly advantageous for field mobility. Candidates must be open to occasional travel to Shillong and Guwahati for official meetings.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though qualified male candidates are also encouraged to apply.
Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview
Round 2: Practical Assignment
Round 3: Final Interview based on Assignment (with Program Lead)
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Role & responsibilities

Job Purpose
To lead and manage all store operations within the cement plant, ensuring efficient receipt, storage, preservation, inventory control, and issuance of materials, spare parts, consumables, and capital items. The role is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, optimizing stock levels, supporting uninterrupted plant operations, and ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and audit requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Store Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day store activities including receipt, inspection, storage, preservation, and issue of materials.
Ensure systematic storage and identification of all inventory items.
Implement best practices in warehouse and store management.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safety standards within store premises.
2. Inventory Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure availability of critical spares and consumables.
Optimize stock holdings to balance operational requirements and inventory carrying costs.
Conduct regular stock verification, cycle counting, and annual physical inventory.
Analyze slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete, and surplus inventory and recommend corrective actions.
3. Material Receipt & Dispatch
Ensure timely receipt and documentation of incoming materials.
Coordinate with procurement, quality, and user departments for material inspection and acceptance.
Manage material issuance as per approved procedures and authorization matrix.
Monitor transportation and dispatch activities where applicable.
4. ERP & Documentation Control
Ensure accurate and timely transactions in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/other ERP platforms).
Maintain inventory records, stock registers, material movement records, and statutory documents.
Generate periodic MIS reports related to inventory, stock valuation, consumption trends, and KPI performance.
5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Liaise with procurement, maintenance, production, finance, and project teams for material planning and availability.
Support plant shutdowns, overhauls, and project activities through effective material management.
Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners regarding deliveries and material discrepancies.
6. Compliance, Audit & Governance
Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
Facilitate internal, external, and statutory audits.
Implement inventory control procedures to prevent losses, pilferage, and material deterioration.
Ensure adherence to ISO, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
7. Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop store personnel.
Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence within the stores function.

Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
About Virohan

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan) , we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare - two of India s fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together - from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If you re excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, you ll find yourself at home at Virohan.

Role Overview

The City Admission Manager will own Virohan s end-to-end performance in the assigned city-driving admissions, centre operations, team productivity, student experience, partner coordination, and local brand growth. This person will act as the single accountable business owner for the city, ensuring that all city-level teams deliver against growth, quality, and profitability goals.

What you ll be responsible for

Conduct market surveys alongside competitors.
Identify additional offerings for students.
Establish connections with educational institutions (schools, junior colleges, coaching classes).
Initiate discussions with HODs for seminar opportunities and other BTL activities.
Identify, onboard, and manage channel partners to expand offline sales reach and drive business growth.
Engage students, highlighting Virohans advantages.
Connect with parents during house visits.
Collect data from 12th board exam centers for attracting fresh students.
Plan canopy activities strategically for better outreach.
Plan and execute marketing activities, generating sales leads.
Manage local BTL activities effectively.
Reach monthly sales targets by nurturing agent relationships and networks.

An ideal candidate should have:

Comfortable with field sales; committed to daily market presence.
Proficient in consultative sale, adept at building trust without being forceful.
Capable of handling sales pressures.
Strong communication skills, particularly in regional languages.
Receptive to feedback, embracing learning from mistakes and setbacks.
Presentable appearance and previous fieldwork experience, preferably in education.
Strong presentation skills with the ability to effectively represent the company to diverse audiences.
Holds 2 to 5 years of marketing experience.

Required Skills
Counselling channel sales B2B partnership Telecalling Channel partnering

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Process, Mines and Quality teams.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Knowledge of laboratory safety and chemical handling procedures.
4. Preferred Experience
Candidates should preferably have:
4+ years of relevant experience in a cement manufacturing plant.
Strong hands-on exposure to XRF operation and analysis.
Experience in cement/clinker/raw material chemical analysis.
Experience working in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance laboratory of a cement plant.
Exposure to BIS/IS standards and cement quality specifications.
Experience with laboratory instruments and calibration/standardization activities.
5. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Accuracy and reliability of laboratory/XRF test results.
Timely completion and reporting of chemical analysis.
Compliance with cement quality specifications.
XRF equipment uptime and proper maintenance.
Reduction of testing errors and quality deviations.
Proper maintenance of laboratory records and documentation.
Compliance with laboratory safety procedures.
Effective coordination with Production and Process departments.
Candidate Profile
Minimum Experience: 4+ Years
Mandatory Industry: Cement Manufacturing
Mandatory Technical Skill: XRF Analysis
Qualification: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry or equivalent
Department: Quality Control
Ideal Candidate: A technically sound Chemistry professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a cement plant, particularly in XRF operation, clinker/cement chemical analysis, raw material testing and quality control, with the ability to independently handle routine laboratory operations and support process-quality improvement.
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Sales Leadership:

Business plans.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
QC Analyst
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform analysis of raw materials, packing materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples as per approved specifications and test methods.
Operate and maintain analytical instruments such as HPLC, GC, UV-Visible Spectrophotometer, FTIR, Dissolution Apparatus, and other laboratory equipment.
Prepare, standardize, and maintain laboratory reagents, volumetric solutions, and reference standards.
Review analytical data, maintain laboratory records, and ensure compliance with GDP, GLP, and data integrity requirements.
Investigate OOS, OOT, laboratory incidents, and deviations as per approved procedures.
Participate in method verification, method transfer, and analytical method validation activities.
Ensure timely completion of sample analysis and reporting.
Support regulatory audits, customer audits, and internal audits.
Follow cGMP, safety, and quality systems requirements.

Microbiologist -
Roles & Responsibilities:
Perform microbiological testing of raw materials, finished products, purified water, and environmental monitoring samples.
Conduct environmental monitoring of manufacturing areas, including viable and non-viable monitoring.
Perform microbial limit tests, sterility testing, endotoxin testing, and growth promotion tests.
Prepare and manage microbiological culture media and microbial cultures.
Carry out water system monitoring and trend analysis.
Maintain microbiology laboratory records in compliance with GDP, GLP, cGMP, and data integrity requirements.
Investigate OOS, OOT, deviations, and microbiological excursions.
Participate in method validation, method suitability studies, and qualification activities.
Ensure laboratory housekeeping, equipment calibration, and compliance with safety requirements.
Support internal, regulatory, and customer audits.

Qualification
B.Sc./M.Sc. (Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology) or equivalent qualification.
Experience
2-4 Years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical formulation/API manufacturing company.
Skills Required
  Knowledge of cGMP, GLP, GDP, and Data Integrity.
Hands-on experience with analytical instruments (for QC Analyst) and microbiological testing techniques (for Microbiologist).
Good documentation and investigation skills.
Exposure to regulatory requirements of USFDA, MHRA, EU GMP, WHO GMP, etc.

Description:
Responsible for providing short-term, specialized patient care, diagnostic monitoring, and minor surgical procedures that do not require overnight hospitalization.

Clinical & Patient Care
Outpatient Consultations (OPD): Conduct primary medical examinations, take comprehensive patient histories, and assess acute or chronic illnesses.
Daycare Management: Supervise and manage short-stay patients undergoing procedures like IV fluid therapies, chemotherapy sessions, dialysis, blood transfusions, or prolonged diagnostic monitoring.
Minor Procedures: Perform or assist in minor surgical or medical procedures such as wound suturing, dressings, incision and drainage (I&D), foreign body removal, and catheterization.
Diagnostic Interpretation: Order and evaluate basic clinical investigations (e.g., blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) to formulate quick and accurate treatment plans.
Emergency & Stabilization
Acute Care & Triage: Identify critical shifts in a patient's vital signs or general condition during their short stay.
Emergency Management: Administer first-line emergency medical care and stabilize patients experiencing sudden medical crises before coordinating transfers to higher care centers.
Operations & Administration
Multidisciplinary Liaison: Coordinate closely with nursing staff, specialist consultants, and administrators to ensure seamless patient care and timely discharges.
Medical Documentation: Maintain highly precise Electronic Medical Records (EMR), including admission notes, procedure records, drug charts, and discharge summaries.
Referrals & Follow-ups: Structure comprehensive discharge guidelines and schedule routine outpatient follow-up care.

Qualifications & Licensing
Degree: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized medical council.
Licensure: Valid and active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC)

The Program Associate will provide strategic and operational support to the District Administration, ensuring effective coordination and convergence among relevant departments across the assigned district and blocks.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in the local language(s) spoken in the assigned community will be preferred.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.

Description:
Professor - Department of Ophthalmology - Job Description

Department: Ophthalmology.

Employment Type: Full-time faculty position.

Role Overview
The Professor of Ophthalmology is a senior faculty position at a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university, uniting patient care, teaching and research. The role combines evidence-based general and subspeciality eye care with delivery of the Competency Based Medical Education (CBME) curriculum prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The Professor mentors junior faculty, residents and interns, guides postgraduate theses, and strengthens the department's research output and academic standing. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Ophthalmology, or to the Dean and Medical Superintendent where the Professor heads the department, as per institutional structure.
Work Mode

Work mode: Work from office, on-campus at the teaching hospital, with working days and on-campus attendance as per teaching hospital and NMC norms, including NMC-mandated faculty attendance recording. No routine travel requirement has been specified; occasional academic, examiner or community outreach duties may be assigned as per institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) Ophthalmology teaching through lectures, small-group sessions, clinical postings and skills-lab training as per the NMC CBME curriculum, including AETCOM components.
Lead postgraduate training of MS Ophthalmology residents through seminars, journal clubs, case presentations, wet-lab sessions and supervised surgical training, where the programme is offered.
Guide and co-guide postgraduate theses, ensuring sound methodology, ethics committee approval and timely submission.
Perform and supervise cataract surgery, including phacoemulsification and manual small incision cataract surgery (MSICS), with documented outcomes and complication audits.
Manage general and subspeciality cases across glaucoma, retina, cornea, oculoplasty, paediatric ophthalmology, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology, co-managing or referring as clinically appropriate.
Conduct outpatient clinics, inpatient rounds and ophthalmic emergency care, including ocular trauma, with accurate and complete clinical documentation.
Supervise and interpret ophthalmic diagnostics such as slit-lamp biomicroscopy, perimetry, optical coherence tomography (OCT), fundus imaging, biometry and B-scan ultrasonography.
Initiate, conduct and publish original research in indexed journals, and pursue intramural and extramural research funding.
Design and conduct formative and summative assessments, and serve as internal or external examiner for university examinations as assigned.
Ensure departmental compliance with NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, faculty norms and documentation for NMC and university inspections.
Mentor and appraise junior faculty, senior residents, postgraduate residents and interns to support their academic and professional growth.
Contribute to community eye-care activities aligned with the National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCBVI), including screening camps where organised.
Uphold patient safety, infection control, informed consent and quality standards, and participate in clinical audits, morbidity reviews and accreditation activities.
Participate in institutional committees, continuing medical education (CME) programmes and departmental planning, including equipment and service development.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a recognised institution, with valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and registration with the State Medical Council of the work-location state as required by norms.
MS Ophthalmology, MD Ophthalmology or DNB Ophthalmology recognised by the NMC; DNB holders must meet NMC equivalence conditions for teaching appointments. A Diploma in Ophthalmology (DO) alone does not qualify for this position.
Eligibility for the post of Professor under the prevailing NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) regulations, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology in an NMC-recognised or permitted medical college.
At least four research publications in indexed journals (PubMed/Medline, Scopus, Embase, Science Citation Index or DOAJ) as first, second, third or corresponding author, with at least two published as Associate Professor, as per NMC criteria.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and the Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME), as required by the NMC.

Required Experience
Experience range: 820 years of post-PG teaching experience in Ophthalmology in NMC-recognised or permitted medical colleges. Minimum: 8 years of post-PG teaching experience, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology. Preferred: 12–20 years combining teaching, high-volume surgical practice and postgraduate thesis guidance; experience as Professor or Head of Department is an advantage. Relevant experience includes faculty roles (Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor) in medical colleges and university teaching hospitals; senior consultant service in NBEMS-accredited teaching departments of government institutions counts only where it meets NMC equivalence norms.

Technical and Functional Skills
Cataract surgery: phacoemulsification and MSICS, including complicated cataracts and management of intraoperative complications.
Glaucoma: gonioscopy, perimetry interpretation, trabeculectomy and laser procedures such as YAG peripheral iridotomy.
Retina: diabetic retinopathy and retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) screening, retinal laser photocoagulation and intravitreal injections.
Cornea and oculoplasty: infective keratitis and ocular surface disease, familiarity with keratoplasty, and lid, lacrimal (such as DCR) and ocular trauma procedures.
Diagnostics and other: paediatric, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology evaluation; OCT, fundus photography, automated perimetry, biometry, B-scan ultrasonography and corneal topography.
Medical education: CBME delivery, competency-based assessment, logbook supervision, and skills-lab and wet-lab teaching.
Research: study design, biostatistics, ethics committee processes, Good Clinical Practice and scientific writing.
Regulatory: NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, TEQ regulations, inspection documentation and NPCBVI norms.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Academic leadership and the ability to build a cohesive, high-performing teaching department.
Clear, compassionate communication with patients, families and multidisciplinary teams.
Mentorship and constructive feedback for students, residents and junior faculty.
Ethical judgement, professionalism and sound decision-making in surgical and emergency settings.
Collaboration with other departments, administration and research teams, and effective time management across clinical, teaching and research duties.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Subspeciality fellowship (glaucoma, vitreoretina, cornea, oculoplasty or paediatric ophthalmology) from a reputed eye institute.
Prior experience as Head of Department or as a university-recognised postgraduate guide.
Advanced Course in Medical Education (ACME), Curriculum Implementation Support Program (CISP) training or a recognised medical education fellowship.
Funded research as principal or co-investigator, publications beyond the NMC minimum, and peer-review or editorial roles.
Experience preparing departments for NMC or university inspections, and membership of professional bodies such as the All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS).

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate will show a progressive academic career from Senior Resident to Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor (or eligibility for Professor) in Ophthalmology, with stable tenures in NMC-recognised medical colleges, university teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary eye-care institutes. Candidates from government, deemed-university and established private medical colleges with active postgraduate programmes are well suited. A consistent record of surgical volume, documented publications and postgraduate guidance is expected, and career gaps or frequent short tenures should be explained in the application.

Compensation and Benefits
The compensation package is competitive and commensurate with qualifications, academic seniority and experience, in line with norms for senior medical faculty. Benefits are as per institutional policy, within an academic environment that supports teaching, research and professional growth. Compensation details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Application Instructions
Send an updated CV mentioning the role "Professor – Ophthalmology" to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. The CV should list qualifications with year and institution, NMC or State Medical Council registration number, designation-wise teaching experience with dates, indexed publications with author position, BCBR and BCME completion, annual surgical volumes, theses guided, current and expected annual CTC in , and notice period in days. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

Description:
Job Description
Working at the heart of a fast-paced fashion business, a Visual Merchandiser will create an environment that inspires customers to explore their personal style. This role will support and guide the store team to deliver the most inspiring and exciting Customer Experience in line with the HM brand and values. You actively drive sales in the store and are responsible to implement the Visual Identity. The Visual Merchandiser will meet the expectations of customers colleagues at all times, as well as follow all HM procedures standards.
This position reports to the Store Manager.
Key Responsibilities
You support the store to achieve a customer first experience through creating a visual identity through the implementation according to HM guidelines.
You support, coach and develop the team on visual and commercial knowledge.
You ensure safety, security and administration procedures are always followed.
You follow up on Store KPIs and initiate actions to reach our business targets, goals budgets.
You plan, execute and follow up sales activities and store campaigns Qualifications
To be successful in the role as a Visual Merchandiser, we believe you have the below mentioned skills experiences:
A multi-tasker who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with an eye for detail, who puts creativity inclusivity together.
1-2+ years of transferrable experience welcome
Ability to stand for long periods of time, bend, stretch, engage in repetitive motions, push, pull and carry items (mannequins, clothing, totes, torsos, etc.) for a short distance
Must be able to work with hand and power operated tools (Iron, Steamer, etc) and lift in order to execute display setups
Must be able to work a flexible work schedule, including nights, weekends and support other stores

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Assistant Professor

Department Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital,

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Assistant Professor in the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy will serve as a key teaching and clinical faculty member at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The role requires a committed medical professional capable of delivering quality undergraduate medical education while managing a robust clinical workload across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings. The incumbent will also contribute to research and publication activities as mandated by the National Medical Commission (NMC). This is an entry-level faculty appointment with strong scope for academic growth within the institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and clinical classes in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy as per university curriculum.
Conduct bedside clinical demonstrations, practical sessions, and case-based discussions for MBBS students and interns.
Participate in departmental seminars, journal clubs, and academic activities to foster a learning environment.
Assist in evaluation and assessment of undergraduate students including internal and university examinations.
Cover duties of other Assistant Professors when required to ensure continuity of academic programmes.

B. Clinical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots, ensuring evidence-based clinical care.

The Associate Professor in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) will hold a senior academic and clinical faculty role at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will lead undergraduate and postgraduate medical teaching in forensic pathology, forensic toxicology, medical jurisprudence, and forensic evidence, while overseeing mortuary operations, toxicology laboratory supervision, and medico-legal case management. This is a faculty leadership role requiring a highly experienced academic with strong publication credentials, deep NMC compliance, and demonstrated expertise in forensic medicine in a teaching hospital setting.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, practical sessions, clinical classes, and demonstrations in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as per university curriculum.

Ensure proper mortuary management, including adherence to safety protocols, infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling of remains.
Conduct and supervise medico-legal autopsies, post-mortem examinations, and forensic evidence collection in accordance with legal and institutional standards.
Prepare medico-legal reports and expert opinions for courts, law enforcement agencies, and institutional authorities as required.
Liaise with judicial, police, and government agencies on medico-legal matters affecting the institution and the community.
Ensure compliance with NABH standards in all forensic and mortuary operations.

Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC criteria, with the candidate among the first three authors.

Lead and contribute to departmental research initiatives in forensic toxicology, forensic pathology, and medico-legal sciences.
Guide postgraduate students in original research and thesis work.

Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national conferences, and forensic medicine professional bodies.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.

(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in FMT, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR

Description:
Role Overview

Position Details: Associate Professor - Paediatrics; 2 positions; Department of Paediatrics; reports to the Professor / Head of Unit; work location: Gangtok, Sikkim.

This mid-senior academic-clinical role combines undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised clinical service, assessment, research guidance, and assigned unit administration. The incumbent will help MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students build safe, evidence-informed paediatric knowledge and practical competence. The role supports high-quality outpatient, inpatient, emergency, NICU, and PICU care while contributing to patient satisfaction and continuous improvement. The Associate Professor works under the Professor / Head of Unit and may lead unit activities when authorised.

Employer Profile: A confidential tertiary-care academic teaching hospital integrating paediatric care, medical education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver competency-based lectures, tutorials, bedside teaching, demonstrations, and clinical discussions for MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students.
Formulate the rotational undergraduate teaching schedule and coordinate faculty inputs to maintain complete, timely academic coverage.
Plan, conduct, and document internal examinations and periodic assessments using approved standards, blueprints, records, and constructive learner feedback.
Supervise seminars, case presentations, journal clubs, clinical postings, procedural learning, and academic mentoring across paediatric services.
Provide outpatient and inpatient paediatric care with the unit team and support evidence-informed diagnosis, treatment, discharge, and follow-up decisions.
Serve as first on call for paediatric emergencies on assigned duty days and escalate difficult or unstable cases promptly.
Supervise or perform appropriate procedures in the NICU, PICU, outpatient department, wards, and emergency settings within authorised privileges.
Report complex, high-risk, and emergency cases to the Unit In-charge or Head of Department and document decisions accurately.
Cover assigned consultant responsibilities during approved leave or service gaps to maintain continuity of teaching and patient care.
Lead assigned unit administration, including duty rosters, work allocation, coordination, and staff guidance, when delegated.
Support need assessment, specification development, procurement inputs, and responsible utilisation of paediatric medical equipment.
Guide learner and departmental research through question development, protocol review, ethical practice, analysis, writing, and dissemination.
Advance patient satisfaction, safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, audit, and continual clinical-service improvement.
Maintain academic, clinical, research, and statutory records while completing other duties assigned by the Head of Department.

Required Qualifications
The candidate must hold an MBBS degree and an NMC-recognised MD or DNB in Paediatrics, or another qualification formally accepted as equivalent under the regulations in force. A valid NMC or State Medical Council registration is mandatory. The candidate must satisfy the applicable Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, including prescribed research-publication, biomedical-research, and medical-education training requirements, as verified at appointment.

Required Experience
The standard academic pathway requires 4+ years as Assistant Professor in Paediatrics at an NMC-recognised medical institution; 5+ years is required where the candidate's applicable NMC route prescribes the longer threshold. Any alternative statutory pathway must be fully documented and independently verified. Relevant experience must include formal undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, clinical supervision, and paediatric patient care. Demonstrated exposure to NICU, PICU, outpatient, inpatient, and emergency services in a teaching-hospital environment is essential.

Technical and Functional Skills
Paediatric clinical assessment, decision-making, documentation, referral, discharge planning, and escalation across OPD, wards, NICU, PICU, and emergencies.
Competency-based medical education, lesson planning, teaching schedules, internal assessment, question setting, evaluation, feedback, and academic recordkeeping.
Clinical supervision of learners and safe oversight of authorised paediatric and neonatal procedures within institutional protocols.
Research methods, ethics, literature appraisal, protocol development, data interpretation, manuscript guidance, and NMC-compliant publication evidence.
Quality improvement, patient safety, infection prevention, audit, duty-roster planning, equipment inputs, and multidisciplinary coordination.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear academic communication, structured feedback, learner mentorship, and respectful collaboration with students, faculty, nurses, and allied teams.
Compassionate family communication, ethical judgement, cultural sensitivity, confidentiality, and calm leadership during paediatric emergencies.
Accountability, dependability, adaptability, prioritisation, conflict resolution, and commitment to continuous professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates with a strong teaching portfolio; completed NMC-recognised faculty-development courses; eligible research publications; demonstrable academic or clinical quality-improvement work; experience guiding postgraduate research; and additional documented competence in neonatology, paediatric intensive care, medical education, or clinical research. These preferences do not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Professional Tenure and Background
Expected progression includes recognised postgraduate training, Senior Residency or an accepted equivalent pathway, and an Assistant Professor appointment meeting the applicable 4+ years or 5+ years NMC threshold. Candidates should show sustained paediatric service, measurable teaching contributions, documented research, and ethical conduct in recognised teaching institutions.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive a competitive, role-aligned compensation package and institutional benefits based on verified qualifications, experience, responsibilities, and internal policy. Exact figures and salary ranges are intentionally not disclosed in this document.

Application Instructions
Submit an updated resume identifying the role, together with MBBS and postgraduate qualification records, medical-registration details, complete teaching-experience certificates, research-publication evidence, and applicable faculty-development certificates. Shortlisting and appointment remain subject to credential, experience, publication, registration, and NMC-eligibility verification.
