Position description: The role involves leading and managing the mechanical operations within the Blast Furnace department at Jindal Ferrous Limited, a key player in steel industry. The position requires overseeing the maintenance, optimization, and reliability of blast furnace mechanical systems to ensure continuous and efficient production. The candidate will be responsible for strategic planning, team leadership, and implementation of best practices to enhance operational performance, safety, and compliance with industry standards. This role demands a seasoned professional with extensive experience in heavy industrial mechanical systems, particularly in blast furnace (more than 1000 m3 capacity) environments, capable of driving innovation and operational excellence in a challenging and dynamic setting.

Primary Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the mechanical maintenance and operational activities of the blast furnace to ensure optimal performance and minimal downtime.
Execute real-time repairs on critical equipment including the blastfurnace top (bell/bell-less top), distribution chutes, and gas seals, GCP, Pumphouse, SGP, STOVE, material handling conveyors etc
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to enhance equipment reliability and lifespan.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams including production, quality, and safety to align mechanical operations with overall plant objectives.
Oversee the troubleshooting and resolution of complex mechanical issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Manage budgeting, resource allocation, and procurement of mechanical parts and services to support blast furnace operations.
Ensure compliance with safety regulations and environmental standards specific to blast furnace mechanical systems.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives through root cause analysis, process optimization, and adoption of new technologies.
Mentor and develop a team of mechanical engineers and technicians, fostering a culture of technical excellence and safety awareness.
Prepare and present detailed reports on mechanical performance, maintenance activities, and project progress to senior management.
Collaborate with vendors and contractors for specialized mechanical services and equipment upgrades.

Get relevant MRO suppliers (spares, consumables, mechanical, electrical & industrial items) quotes, negotiate, and start relationship for price analysis and conversion to favourable delivery and credit terms.

Description:
About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity. We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs.
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos. We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit.
Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products.
Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers.
Drive & ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels.
Maintaining quality portfolio by tracking& controlling ROI .
Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base.
Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control.
Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking & Financial Services can applyfor the role.
Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply.
In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults. Brand building through field marketing is also a key component.
CTC Upto 2.37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2.8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
Job Purpose
The Technical Manager (TM) is responsible for managing the technicalcollateral evaluation process at branch and regional levels, ensuringtimely property valuations, APF/CF approvals, vendor management, and TATadherence . The role focuses on risk mitigation, query reduction, andoperational excellence , while supporting Zonal Technical Managers inportfolio quality management.
Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Execution
Conduct and review APF, Non-APF, and CF property cases withindelegated authority.
Ensure site visits, valuations, documentation, andrecommendations are complete and accurate.
Flag high-risk or red-category cases to RTM / ZTM for review.
2. TAT & QualityCompliance
Monitor TAT adherence for branch submissions and vendor reports.
Track First-Time-Right (FTR)performance , identify rework areas, and implement corrective measures.
Support query resolution and queryreduction initiatives .

3. Vendor Management
Coordinate with vendors forvaluations and technical reports .
Track vendor performance,cost, and quality , escalating issues to RTM / ZTM.
Support vendor onboarding,training, and periodic review .
4. Branch & BusinessSupport
Support branches in APF/CFgeneration within approved limits .
Visit properties exceedingthreshold amounts (e.g., >1 Cr.) and support high-value case assessments .
Provide feedback to RTM/ZTM onbranch-level risk trends, exceptions, and performance gaps.

5. Compliance & AuditSupport
Ensure branch-level activitiescomply with technical policies, regulatory norms, and audit standards .
Support internal and externalaudits with documentation and clarifications .
6. Reporting & Insights
Prepare branch/regional MISreports on TAT, FTR, vendor performance, and query trends.
Highlight operational bottlenecks and recommend processimprovement

Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.

Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Expert, AVP
Location: Bangalore, India
Deutsche Bank is committed to being the best financial services provider in the world, balancing passion with precision to deliver superior solutions for our clients. This is made possible by our people: agile minds, able to see beyond the obvious and act effectively in an ever-changing global business landscape. As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job Title- Business Control Analyst, NCT
Location- Jaipur, India


Role Description
The person will be responsible for day-to-day review of voice logs between Client Relationship Managers (RC) and clients where trade details are discussed and agreed. He/she needs to ensure that all key trade-related details are clearly discussed, accurately captured, and documented in the applicable product-specific template. The role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to defined review standards, timely completion of assigned production duties, and appropriate escalation of exceptions, missing information, or first-level queries within the pre-specified timelines. The candidate should also act as a backup for peers when required and share best practices with the team to support consistent quality delivery.


Your key responsibilities
Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details have been discussed and agreed as per the required standards.
Listen to and understand client and RMs discussions and accurately document the agreed details or the prescribed business template, as applicable.
Complete the relevant product-specific voice log review template with accurate details, observations, and outcome of the review.
Identify and highlight missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions to the relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of daily production activities in line with defined SLAs, cut-off times, and quality expectations.
Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Assist in preparing and reviewing daily control / production reports, including tracking of open items, exceptions, and follow-ups.
Support follow-up with RC / business teams for clarification or resolution of deficiencies noted during voice log review.
Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes to support internal control, audit, and management reporting requirements.
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders on complex cases, escalations, reporting requirements, and process improvements.
Act as backup for peers during absence and support knowledge sharing, cross-training, and continuous improvement within the team.
Perform other administration, reporting, and control-related tasks as assigned.


Your skills and experience
Minimum educational qualification: University graduate with a Bachelor s Degree.
Good command of business English for accurate documentation, exception reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, banking / wealth management products, or control review processes will be an added advantage.
Strong listening, comprehension, documentation, and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential control issues from recorded conversations.
Candidates are required to be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Highly motivated, quality-focused, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to multi-task and work under pressure to meet production timelines, cut-off times, and quality standards.
Good communication skills and ability to manage routine queries / first-level escalations professionally.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job Summary
Role Overview: We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer who can independently design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end Agentic AI applications using React.js and Python. You will be responsible for taking a business requirement, breaking it into modules, deciding the application architecture, designing data structures and APIs, integrating AI components, and delivering a fully functional, production-ready solution. Need someone who can think independently, make technical decisions, integrate services, and take complete ownership of the application lifecycle as a Indidual Contributor.


Responsibilities
End-to-End Development: Build complete AI applications using React.js for the frontend and Python for the backend.
Solution Design: Understand business requirements, divide work into modules, and define application architecture, data structures, and API requirements.
Agentic AI Development: Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, tool calling, and frameworks such as Lang Chain and Lang Graph.
Service Integration: Integrate third-party APIs, databases, AI models, MCP servers, and other required services and protocols.
Database Design: Design and manage relational databases and vector databases based on application requirements.
Deployment Infrastructure: Handle end-to-end deployment, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud infrastructure, and production releases.
Testing Quality: Perform end-to-end testing, including unit, integration, functional, and smoke testing, to ensure application reliability.
Performance Security: Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and follow secure coding and deployment practices.
Ownership Communication: Work independently, communicate effectively with stakeholders, provide regular updates, and support off-hours activities when required by business needs.


Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend development.
Strong Python programming skills with experience in Fast API, Django, or similar backend frameworks.
Practical experience building and deploying end-to-end AI applications.
Good understanding of LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI agent workflows.
Experience with frameworks such as Lang Chain or Lang Graph.
Understanding of MCP, tool calling, function calling, and API integrations.
Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, REST APIs, and data modelling.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and production deployments.
Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Py-Test and Jest.

Description:
Entry level management position that is responsible for leading and assisting with the successful completion of daily shift requirements.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction and achieve the operating budget.
Assists in completing ficial and administrative responsibilities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supports all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Coaches, counsels and encourages employees.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Supports all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Front Desk Manager.
- Guides daily Front Desk shift operations.
- Communicates performance expectations to employees in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Trains staff on adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and property occupancy.
- Understands the impact of Front Desk operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implementing the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.
- Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences and aid in problem resolution.
Supporting Handling of Human Resource Activities
- Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Provides feedback to individuals based on observation of service behaviors.
- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Role Clarity: Business Development Manager
Reporting To : Zonal Sales Manager

Role Definition:
The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving growth by identifying and acquiring new customers within the zone. This role involves prospecting, customer profiling, building relationships, and promoting the organizations brand and services to achieve sales targets and expand the market.

Deliverables:
Market Research and Analysis
Customer Acquisition and Pipeline Development
Customer Relationship Management
Sales Process Management
Reporting and Performance Analysis

Key Responsibilities:

Prospecting and Customer Acquisition:
Conduct market research in the zone to identify industry trends, competition, potential customers and growth opportunities.
Prospect potential customers from various channels, including clinicians, Corporate hospitals, SIS, Franchisee partners, and corporate industries. Reach out to a minimum of 200 new prospects each month.
Implement field level lead generation plan to build a pipeline of qualified leads. Generate at least 25 qualified leads per month.

MSL Development and Management:
Develop and update an MSL of a minimum of 150 potential customers every quarter for conversion, engagement, and building brand visibility
Regular meeting with identified potential customers to nurture relationships and explore business opportunities. Conduct at least 10 meetings with potential customers every day.

Customer Profiling and Needs Assessment:
Createa profiling of potential customers to understand their needs, desires. Identify customer pain points and business challenges through needs assessment.
Segment the customer based on criteria of A, B, C, and D Customer to prioritize outreach efforts.

Solution Offering:
Create and present the elevator pitch, tailored solutions, products and proposals that address customer needs and align with service offerings.
Collaborate with the Product and Centre of Excellence team to develop and manage scientific content and promotional materials for effective communication with customers. Communicate scientific literature detailing product features, benefits, and advantages to the target audience.
Handle objections and close deals in collaboration with Zonal Managers to ensure customer conversion.

Account Management:
Schedule regular follow up visits with existing customers to review their needs, satisfaction levels, and any issues they may have.
Plan and execute business activities such as RTMs,CMEs, Product-led scientific seminars, and other community engagement based on business needs and objectives. Engage a minimum of 30% of MSL through such activities every quarter.

Sales Process Management:
Manage the end-to-end sales process from lead generation to contract closure and post-sales follow-up.
Log all sales activities daily in the LIMS Sales module to track progress, update records, and analyze sales performance metrics.
Prepare reports and presentations on sales performance, sales funnel status, and market insights every month.

Success Metrics:
Generate at least 25 qualified leads per month
Conduct a minimum of 10 meetings with potential customers daily
Achieve a 30% conversion rate on presented proposals
Achieve minimum 75% MSL productivity

Role Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA in Marketing or Healthcare Management will be an added advantage.
Relevant Experience 1-4 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, or Marketing within the healthcare or related industry, with diagnostic industry experience preferred.
Proven ability in prospecting, lead generation, and pipeline development, with a track record of achieving sales targets and converting leads into long-term business relationships.
Experience in engaging with clinicians, hospitals, corporate clients, and franchise partners, demonstrating strong networking and customer relationship management skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate scientific and diagnostic service offerings.
Sound understanding of healthcare market trends and competition, along with proficiency in sales reporting and CRM/LIMS systems to track performance and derive actionable insights.

JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential. Manages group/catering opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC). Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity. Achieves personal and team related revenue goals. Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience. Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Analyst
Corporate Title: Analyst
Location: Jaipur
Responsibilities
The person will be responsible for day-to-day review of voice logs between Client Relationship Managers (RC) and clients where trade details are discussed and agreed. They need to ensure that all key trade-related details are clearly discussed, accurately captured, and documented in the applicable product-specific template. The role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to defined review standards, timely completion of assigned production duties, and appropriate escalation of exceptions, missing information, or first-level queries within the pre-specified timelines. The candidate should also act as a backup for peers when required and share best practices with the team to support consistent quality delivery.
Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details have been discussed and agreed as per the required standards.
Listen to and understand client discussions conducted in English and Chinese language (Mandarin and Cantonese) and accurately document the agreed details in English or the prescribed business template, as applicable.
Complete the relevant product-specific voice log review template with accurate details, observations, and outcome of the review.
Identify and highlight missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions to the relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of daily production activities in line with defined SLAs, cut-off times, and quality expectations.
Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Assist in preparing and reviewing daily control / production reports, including tracking of open items, exceptions, and follow-ups.
Support follow-up with RC / business teams for clarification or resolution of deficiencies noted during voice log review.
Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes to support internal control, audit, and management reporting requirements.
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders on complex cases, escalations, reporting requirements, and process improvements.
Act as backup for peers during absence and support knowledge sharing, cross-training, and continuous improvement within the team.
Perform other administration, reporting, and control-related tasks as assigned.
Your skills and experience
Minimum educational qualification: University graduate with a Bachelor s Degree.
Chinese Language Proficiency (Mandarin and/or Cantonese): Candidate must be able to understand spoken client conversations, interpret financial and investment terminology, and accurately document agreed trade details in English using prescribed Voice Log Review templates.
Good command of business English for accurate documentation, exception reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, banking / wealth management products, or control review processes will be an added advantage.
Strong listening, comprehension, documentation, and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential control issues from recorded conversations.
Candidates are required to be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Highly motivated, quality-focused, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to multi-task and work under pressure to meet production timelines, cut-off times, and quality standards.
Good communication skills and ability to manage routine queries / first-level escalations professionally.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Reportingto Store Manager

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

About This Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Software Developer - BMC Helix to join our team and take ownership of the development, integration deployment of BMC Remedy/Helix ITSM applications in enterprise environments. In this role, you will work across the full application lifecycle - from design and development to integration and support - ensuring the platform is aligned with business processes and ITIL best practices. What You Will Do

- Develop, configure, and customize BMC Remedy AR System (ARS 8.0+) and BMC Remedy ITSM Suite modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, SRM, SLM, and Knowledge Management
- Manage Foundation Data - including creation, updates, and deletion - and configure ITSM components end-to-end
- Administer Remedy Server and Mid-Tier - covering AR Server, Approval Server, Email Engine, Reporting, and Audit Logging configuration
- Perform installation, upgrades, feature design, development, and data loads for BMC Remedy/Helix applications
- Build and maintain integrations with third-party and B2B systems; lead migrations and consolidation of disparate systems into an enterprise ITSM infrastructure
- Provide technical support across the Remedy Suite - including ADDM, BCM, CMDB, and Asset Management - across production, test, and development environments
- Manage Change Management approvals, assignments, notification mechanisms, SLM, and end-to-end CM lifecycle
- Perform bug fixes, workflow enhancements, and troubleshoot applications at workflow and database levels
- Translate business requirements into application designs using best-practice technical solutions; create and maintain design specifications and architectural diagrams
- Support all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

What You Will Bring

- 2- 7 years hands-on development experience with BMC Remedy AR System and BMC/Helix ITSM applications
- Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL
- Strong understanding of third-party and B2B integration architecture with Remedy
- Experience with enterprise migrations and consolidation of ITSM platforms
- Ability to create and maintain architectural diagrams, design specifications, and process documentation
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- End-to-end architecture visibility with the ability to understand application, integration, and infrastructure dependencies
- Demonstrated ownership and accountability in delivering solutions and resolving issues

Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Business Management, or related discipline.
MBA (Marketing/Business Development) will be an added advantage.
Key Responsibilities
Drive business growth by identifying and developing new opportunities with Pharma, Biotech, and Healthcare customers.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision-makers, and industry stakeholders.

Proven track record in achieving business development and revenue targets within Pharma, CRO, CDMO, Clinical Research, Bioanalytical, or Analytical Testing Services.
Strong understanding of pharmaceutical drug development, testing services, and regulatory requirements.
Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
Strong verbal, written communication, and presentation skills.
Ability to independently manage key accounts and business opportunities.
Strategic thinking with strong commercial acumen.
Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings and business development activities.
Preferred Experience
Experience in handling Pharma and Biotech customer accounts across India and global markets.
Exposure to proposal management, contract negotiations, budgeting, and forecasting.
Existing customer network within Pharma, Biotechnology, CRO, or related industries will be preferred.

Job Description :
We are looking for an experienced Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to support the design, configuration, implementation, and maintenance of financial planning and analysis solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, reporting, and Adaptive Planning configuration.
Key Responsibilities
Implement, configure, and maintain Workday Adaptive Planning solutions based on business requirements.
Work closely with finance and FP&A teams to understand budgeting, forecasting, and reporting needs.
Develop and maintain planning models, sheets, dimensions, calculated accounts, formulas, and assumptions.
Configure financial models for revenue, expenses, workforce planning, and operational planning.
Create reports, dashboards, and management reporting solutions.
Perform variance analysis and support financial planning and forecasting activities.
Integrate Adaptive Planning with Workday Financial Management, ERP systems, and other data sources.
Support data loading, validation, reconciliation, and integration troubleshooting.
Conduct unit testing, system testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment activities.
Troubleshoot application issues and provide ongoing production support.
Prepare functional documentation, configuration documents, and user training materials.
Required Skills
Hands-on experience with Workday Adaptive Planning / Adaptive Insights.
Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.
Experience configuring planning sheets, dimensions, calculated accounts, formulas, and assumptions.
Knowledge of financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.
Experience with data integration, data validation, and reconciliation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work with finance stakeholders and translate business requirements into system solutions.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Workday Financial Management or other ERP systems.
Knowledge of Workday integrations, EIB, APIs, or ETL tools, where relevant to the role.
Experience in end-to-end Adaptive Planning implementation.
Exposure to workforce planning, headcount planning, and scenario modelling.
Relevant Workday Adaptive Planning certification, if applicable.

Description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)
Description
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
Responsibilities
Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
Critical Situation management
SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
Data Analytics & System trend analysis
Typical Skills and Background
4+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

ServiceNow ITOM Developer
Experience: 2-6 Years
Location: Pune / Bangalore / Noida/Mumbai
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Developer with 2-6 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITOM modules, particularly Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB.
The candidate will be responsible for developing, configuring, integrating and supporting ITOM solutions to improve infrastructure visibility, service health and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Configure, customize and develop ServiceNow ITOM solutions based on business and technical requirements.
Work on ServiceNow Discovery, including Discovery Schedules, Credentials, MID Server, Discovery Patterns, Probes and Sensors.
Configure and maintain Service Mapping to identify application and infrastructure dependencies.
Work on Event Management, including event ingestion, event rules, alert management, CI binding and event correlation.
Maintain and enhance CMDB, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation.
Work with MID Servers and troubleshoot connectivity, credential and discovery-related issues.
Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and third-party monitoring/infrastructure tools using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB-related issues.
Develop and maintain ServiceNow scripts using JavaScript where required.
Work with infrastructure, network, application and cloud teams to resolve ITOM-related technical issues.
Analyze and resolve issues related to CI discovery, duplicate CIs, incorrect relationships and failed discovery.
Support CMDB data quality, accuracy and governance initiatives.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in knowledge-sharing activities.
Follow ServiceNow development and implementation best practices.
Required Skills
26 years of experience in ServiceNow development/ITOM.
Hands-on experience with one or more ITOM modules, preferably:
Discovery
Service Mapping
Event Management
CMDB
Good understanding of MID Server architecture and configuration.
Knowledge of Discovery Patterns, Probes, Sensors and Discovery Schedules.
Understanding of Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) and CI identification.
Knowledge of CI classes, relationships and CMDB data model.

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.

Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills

Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset

Job Description

LLMs: GPT-4, GPT- 4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, Gemini
Vector Databases: FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate
Cloud Platforms: Azure (OpenAI, ML Studio), AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI)
DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring Tools: LangSmith, Grafana, Splunk
Other Tools: Streamlit, FastAPI, Flask for UI/API development

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field

Responsibilities

Data Onboarding & Support

Support data storage and processing using Amazon S3 as the core cloud storage layer, ensuring data is organized, secure, and accessible.
Support metadata management and data cataloging using AWS Glue Data Catalog to facilitate discoverability and governance.
Assist in implementing data validation, quality checks, and lineage documentation.
Write and maintain Python scripts and Big data processing engines transformations for data ingestion, processing, and automation tasks.


Platform & Pipeline Maintenance

Support operational activities such as deployment, testing, and routine monitoring.
Contribute to automation of deployment and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.


Collaboration & Documentation
Work with senior engineers to understand platform standards and best practices.
Document onboarding steps, pipeline configurations, and operational procedures.

Operational Support

Support routine deployment, testing, and monitoring activities.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing and documentation efforts.


Required Qualifications

Hands-on experience with programming in Python or similar languages for data processing and automation.

Understanding of data onboarding, data quality, metadata, and lineage concepts.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS IAM, and AWS CloudWatch.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Job Description: Deal Desk Associate (Offshore)
Role Overview
The Deal Desk Associate serves as the foundational execution engine for daily, high-volume quote-to-order operations. Acting as a critical operational bridge between frontline field sales and the onshore Deal Desk, this role focuses on case triage, administrative execution, system workaround resolution, and standard quote generation.
The primary objective of this role is to eliminate operational friction and scale senior Deal Desk capacity by managing standard and recurring activities as the team evolves into a strategic "Revenue Architecture" engine.
Core Objectives & Impact
Accelerate Transaction Velocity: Drive high throughput and rapid SLAs for routine Deal Desk requests and activities.
Maintain Absolute Data Hygiene: Ensure data accuracy across Salesforce (SFDC) and CPQ systems to eliminate downstream billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition bottlenecks.
Deflect Administrative Drag: Triage incoming cases, enforce self-service engagement for basic queries, and route non-commercial tickets to cross-functional teams.
Enable Strategic Onshore Focus: Handle foundational operational tasks so onshore Deal Desk resources can focus on strategic, complex, nuanced and high dollar value activities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Case Triage, Queue Management & Deflection
Monitor regional Salesforce case queues (AMER, EMEA, or APAC) and apply priority tags to maintain intake governance.
Validate intake completeness (e.g. Custom SKU requests) and clarity of incoming requests before handing them off to onshore Deal Desk teams.
Redirect sellers asking basic operational or "how-to" questions to self-service enablement platforms (e.g., Genie, Assistant, Highspot job aids).
Identify and transfer out-of-scope non-commercial requests (e.g., VAT updates, billing address changes, standard NDAs) directly to Legal or Accounting.
2. Quoting & Administrative Execution
Manage standard "generate paper" requests due to seller system limitations or specific segment use cases (e.g., public sector, WORD for redline requests).
Manually adjust Subscription Orders (SO) and Statements of Work (SOW) to complete data requirements or format to meet customer requirements.
Fulfill and attach standard pre-signed contract exhibits, including DORA, DPA, BAA, Code of Conduct, Security Standards, and Letters of Authorization, within guidelines.
Generate ad-hoc $0 amendment orders for standard policy terms (e.g., Generative AI opt-in agreements).
Support the M.A.C.S. process.
Track Sales Order rejections in coordination with Order Management to resolve data mismatches.
Resolve routine CPQ lockout errors and quote save failures for Sales.
Execute ad-hoc Salesforce user acceptance testing (UAT) on enhancement requests.
Required Skills & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience: 0-2+ years of experience in business support or order management.
System Proficiency: Hands-on experience or familiarity with enterprise CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and CPQ tools.
Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision in checking data inputs, contract terms, and system configurations.
Process Compliance: Strict adherence to established playbooks, workflows, and escalation protocols.
Communication: Clear, concise communication skills.
Problem-Solving & Coachability: Strong desire to learn, adapt to workflow changes quickly, and take feedback constructively.

Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border services, B2B & B2C warehousing, and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which include large and small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises and brands.

Role Details:
Position: Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Noida and Mumbai
Working Days: 6 Days

About Delhivery: Delhivery is a leading logistics and supply chain services company in India, founded in 2011. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality, and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities. We are disrupting Indias logistics industry through our proprietary network design, infrastructure, partnerships, and engineering and technology capabilities. Delhivery brings unparalleled cost efficiency and pan-India reach to the businesses of over 15,000 customers. Our team has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion orders to more than 420 million households across India. 20 automated sort centers, 71+ fulfillment centers, 65+ hubs, 2200+ direct delivery centers, 5000+ partner centers, and 39,200+ team members make it possible to deliver over 1.5M packages a day.

Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and strategic Manager to manage partners for our platform and grow loyalty towards Delhivery.

Role Overview: We are seeking a proactive Manager Supply to strengthen relationships with our delivery partners and drive long-term loyalty towards the Delhivery platform.

This role will focus on improving partner onboarding, partner satisfaction, performance, and retention, while ensuring high standards of productivity, compliance, and engagement across the partner ecosystem.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Partner Engagement & Relationship Management Vendor Management & Onboarding – Identify, onboard, and maintain a strong vendor base for fleet requirements. Build and maintain strong relationships with delivery partners (loyal partners). Conduct regular engagement activities, recognition programs, and feedback sessions to enhance partner motivation and loyalty. Resolve partner grievances promptly to ensure high satisfaction and minimal attrition. Act as a bridge between partners and internal teams (operations, HR, product) for smooth communication and issue resolution.

2. Partner Performance & Retention Monitor partner-level performance metrics (attendance, delivery quality, productivity, etc.). Identify top-performing and at-risk partners and design targeted retention initiatives. Develop incentive and recognition programs to reward consistent, high-performing partners. Drive reduction in partner churn and ensure a stable, reliable delivery network.

3. Process & Compliance Ensure all partners adhere to Delhivery’s operational and safety guidelines. Maintain updated documentation and records for all partner interactions and activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely onboarding, training, and policy awareness among partners.

4. Data Analysis & Reporting Track and analyze partner satisfaction, retention rates, and performance metrics.

Prepare regular dashboards and insights to identify trends and areas for improvement.

Recommend data-driven interventions to improve partner experience and operational outcomes.

Key Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, or a related field (MBA preferred).

3–6 years of experience in on-ground partner management, fleet engagement, or delivery operations, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or mobility sectors.

Strong people management and relationship-building skills. Ability to analyze data and drive actionable insights.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to travel locally and work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Description:
The SR DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER will be a key member of the Campaign Analytics team, responsible for transforming marketing intelligence through AI, automation, advanced analytics, and performance insights. This role will drive data-driven decision-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 812 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Description:
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 8–12 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
Role- Individual Contributor
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Apply the engineering authoring rules.

Must have experience of interpreting engineering drawings, software and system level documentation
Must have experience in using and producing documentations at System (AMM, AIPC, MP, IPD, FIM, TSM, AWD etc.) and Product level (CMM, ACMM, CMP etc.).

Must have experience of using TechData Editing tools in SGML, XML or other format (ADAM Author, PTC Arbortext, Notepad etc.)
Must have experience of using TechData Managing tools (ADAM Manager or other)

Description:
ML Engineer (MLOps) Job Description
Experience: 0–5 Years
Location: Pan India
Role Overview
We are looking for an ML Engineer who can work across Machine Learning model development and the operational lifecycle of ML systems. The role combines model development, training, evaluation, deployment, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring and production support, with a strong preference for open-source tooling.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, train, validate and optimize Machine Learning models.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering and model evaluation.
Build reproducible ML training and inference workflows.
Package and deploy ML models as production services.
Design ML pipelines covering data, training, validation, deployment and monitoring.
Implement CI/CD and automation for ML applications and models.
Manage model versions, experiments, artifacts and release processes.
Containerize workloads using Docker and deploy them on suitable infrastructure.
Implement model/application logging, metrics, monitoring and alerting.
Optimize inference latency, resource utilization and scalability.
Work with Kubernetes and container orchestration where applicable.
Collaborate with AI Engineers, Data Engineers and Full Stack Developers.
Deploy, serve, and manage machine learning models across development and production environments, including model versioning and lifecycle management.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate model deployment and ML application releases.
Core Technical Skills
Strong Python programming.
Machine Learning fundamentals: regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering and model evaluation.
Machine Learning Models
Ability to select the appropriate model based on the business problem, dataset characteristics, performance requirements, and production constraints.
Feature Engineering, Feature Selection, Hyperparameter Tuning, Model Optimization, and Model Explainability.
Model Selection & Evaluation: cross-validation, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, confusion matrix, RMSE, MAE, and appropriate business metrics.
Dimensionality Reduction: PCA and related techniques.
Recommendation Systems: collaborative filtering, content-based approaches, and hybrid recommendation techniques.
Time-Series: forecasting, trend/seasonality analysis, and time-series model evaluation.
Clustering: K-Means, DBSCAN, hierarchical clustering, and related methods.
Boosting: XGBoost, LightGBM, and similar gradient-boosting techniques.
Classification: Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, SVM, KNN, Naive Bayes, and ensemble methods.
Regression: Linear Regression, Ridge/Lasso, and related approaches.
Scikit-learn and practical ML development experience.
PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
Git, Linux, shell scripting and software engineering practices.
REST APIs and model-serving concepts.
Docker and CI/CD fundamentals.
SQL and basic data pipeline knowledge.
Understanding of cloud or infrastructure concepts.
Preferred / Additional Skills
MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry and lifecycle management.
Kubeflow, KServe or Seldon for ML workflows/serving.
Apache Airflow, Prefect or Dagster for workflow orchestration.
Kubernetes and Helm.
Terraform or OpenTofu for infrastructure as code.
Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring.
OpenTelemetry, Loki and/or ELK/OpenSearch for observability.
Argo CD / Argo Workflows or GitLab CI for automation.
Feast or another open-source feature store.
Kafka for event-driven ML/data workflows.
DVC, AWS Sagemaker, AWS Bedrock
